tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅/ /'grel pa don gsal gyi ngag don bzhugs so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i ngag don sbas don zab mo'i gnad kyi sgron me zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag lta ba gang la lta/ /ji ltar lta ba rnam dag kyang / /yang dag don la lta ba'i tshul/ /ston mdzad bla ma lhar bcas mchod/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag nyer zhi'i go 'phang mchog brnyes thog ma mi mngon yang / /ting 'dzin mngal ldan stong nyid yum la thabs mkhas sa bon gyis bskrun nas/ /snying rje'i ma mas bskyangs pa'i rgyal sras tshul 'dzin slar yang mi mjed 'dir/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pas grangs med chos sgo 'byed mdzad mi pham mgon la 'dud/ /mgon po gang gi gsung rab mchog la sngon sbyang bag chags sad pa dang / /tshe 'dir dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung zhing brtson pa du mas sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /nges don zab mo'i don la mi 'jigs spobs pa thob pa las/ /'dir ni ngag don gnad kyi sgron me gzur gnas blo ldan rnams la sbyin/ /'di la gsum ste/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag yan lag can gyi bstan bcos/ bstan bcos ji ltar bsgyur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ tha snyad rtogs pa'i don du mtshan gyi don/ gzhung tshad rtogs pa'i don du bam po'i grangs/ gus pas 'jug pa'i don du phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyaṃ garaṃ rngog lo tsā bas 'grel pa don gsal bsgyur ba'i thog mar mtshan don smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi glegs bam btsal sla ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ des de'i thog mar rgya skad smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bstan bcos khungs btsun par shes pa dang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la bag chags 'jog pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ des de'i thog mar bod skad smos pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ dbang rtul gyis ming tsam shes pa dang / dbang rnon gyis brjod byar rags pa rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bam po/ des de'i thog mar bam grangs smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gzhung grangs lhag chad spong ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sangasaṃ rgyasaṃ des de'i thog mar yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'gyur gyi bar chad zhi ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bshad pa la 'jug pa/ bshad pa nyid nye bar 'god pa/ bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mchod par brjod pa'i don/ slob dpon snga mas ji ltar phye ba'i tshul/ rang nyid kyis 'grel pa'i rgyu'o/ /dang po ni/ shesaṃ rabaṃ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos 'grel pa don gsal rtsom pa'i thog mar phyag 'tshal ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus pa kun gyi rgyan du dbye ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ thogs med kyis rnam bshad mdzad tshul/ dbyig gnyen gyis rnam par bkral tshul/ 'phags pa grol sdes rnam par phye tshul/ btsun pa grol sdes rnam bshad byas tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'gro la bsam sbyor gyi yon tan khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i thogs med chos can/ bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad de/ mi pham mgon po las dngos su gsan pa la brten nas de nyid rnam nges brtsams pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'groṃ donaṃ 'gro don mchog tu gyur pa'i dbyig gnyen chos can/ bstan bcos chen po rnam par bkrol te/ sems tsam gyi grub mtha' la brten nas gzhung 'grel brtsams pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'phagasaṃ pa'iṃ 'phags pa'i sa brnyes pa'i grol sde chos can/ bstan bcos chen po rnam par phye ste/ dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' la brten nas nyi khri snang ba brtsams pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ deṃ yiṃ dad pa'i sa la gnas pa'i grol sde chos can/

bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad byas te/ rang gi rtogs pa dang mthun par nyi khri rnam 'grel brtsams pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ rang gis rtogs pa gzhan las khyad par du zhugs pa/ dbye bar rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ khengs pa skyung ste brtsams par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ seng bzang chos can/ 'grel byed gzhan las ya mtshan che ste/ dbyig gnyen dang btsun grol gyis ma rnyed pa'i rgyan gyi tshig don rnyed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ yum don chos can/ khyod phyin ci ma log par rnyed pa'i mkhas pas dbye bar rigs te/ khyod rtog ges rnyed par dka' zhing sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyis rnyed dgos pas zab mo'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ seng bzang chos can/ yum don khyod kyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul ma yin yang 'grel pa rtsom pa la spro ba bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'grel pa brtsams pas rang gzhan la phan 'dogs par 'dod pa'i so skye yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bshad pa nyid nye bar 'god pa la gsum ste/ brjod bya mngon rtogs la 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ rjod byed bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon par rtogs pa'o/ /dang po la/ mtshams sbyar/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'phagaṃs paṃ mgon po byams pas rgyan brtsams pa'i thog mar yum la mchod par brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya gzhan yum la dwang ba skyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gdul bya gzhan yum la dwang ba skyed pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ yum la don gyis 'jug pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyaṃn thosaṃ byams mgon chos can/ yum la mchod par brjod pa yin te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi skye med gsum rtogs pa'i mkhyen pas sangs rgyas 'phags pa skyed byed kyi yum byed pa dang /

sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i skye med gsum rtogs pa'i mkhyen pas rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen byed pa dang / 'phags pa so so'i skye med gsum rtogs pa'i mkhyen pas 'phags pa so so'i bzhed don sgrub pa'i yum byed pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas yum la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ chos can de nyid thugs dgyes par gyur cig gsum pa la bzhi ste/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ brgal lan no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dgos pa'i rkyen/ dgos pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ tshigaṃs suṃ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs kyis yum gyi yon tan brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang po rno rtul gnyis yum la dwang ba bskyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dgos pa so so'i rang bzhin/ thun mong gi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos kyi dgos pa/ brgyud pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dbang rtul dwang ba skye tshul dang / dbang rnon dwang ba skye tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ deṃ thoṃs nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ khyod la brten nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang rtul dwang ba bskyed de/ khyod la brten nas yum la yon tan yod med mi dpyod par myur du dwang ba skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ choṃs kyiṃ snga ma de chos can/ khyod la brten nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang rnon yum la dwang ba skye ste/ khyod la brten nas de mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i yum byed tshul la gnod pa ma mthong nas dwang ba skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de la mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang po rno rtul gnyis yum la dwang ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ yum brjod byar ston pa'i gsung rab la thos bsam gyis 'jug pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis de la 'jug pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/

bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ'i phyiraṃ 'bras yum la dwang ba'i dad pa chos can/ byang chub gsum gyi rtogs rigs 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ de'i thog ma'i byed rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ laṃ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas yum la bstod pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus shing / mngon rtogs brgyad la 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don bsgrub pa'i rtogs rigs tshang ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i tshigs bcad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa/ don bsdus te 'phags bzhi'i yum du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ gzhi shes kyi yon tan brjod pa ni/ nyaṃn thosaṃ gzhi shes chos can/ nyan rang gi rigs can nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ nyan rang gi rigs can nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par byed pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lam shes kyi yon tan brjod pa ni/ byangaṃ chuṃb lam shes chos can/ byang chub sems dpas gzhan don sgrub pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ byang chub sems dpas gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen gyi yon tan brjod pa ni/ rnaṃm paṃ rnam mkhyen chos can/ sangs rgyas kyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i yon tan dang ldan te/ sangs rgyas kyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ saṃngs rgyasaṃ 'bras yum chos can/ byams mgon gyi bstod phyag gi yul yin te/ mchog gi sprul sku'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ brgal ba dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pas dngos su mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pas shugs la mkhyen gsum gyi rgyan rtsom par dam bcas na gzhi kho na brjod byar bsdus pas mkhyen gsum gyi rgyan rtsom mam/

lam kho na brjod byar bsdus pas de'i rgyan rtsom mam/ rnam pa kho na brjod byar bsdus pas de'i rgyan rtsom/ dang po ltar na/ chos mngon pa dang zlos pa'i skyon yod/ gnyis pa ltar na/ spang bya mi rtogs pa'i skyon yod/ gsum pa ltar na/ skyes bu la nye bar mkho ba'i don ma bshad pa'i skyon yod do ce na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gtan tshigs 'god/ sgrub byed bshad/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ niṃ rgyan chos can/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa gang rung re re kho na brjod byar bsdus pa la bkod pa'i skyon yod pa ma yin te/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa'i phyogs gsum char brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ des na rgyan chos can/ 'phags pa bzhi char gyi rtogs rigs brjod byar bsdus te/ mkhyen gsum brjod byar bsdus pa gang zhig mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags pa bzhi char gyi rtogs rigs bsdus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lung 'god pa/ lung gi don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ yum bar ma'i lung 'god/ bsdus pa'i lung 'god/ rgyas pa'i lung khungs 'god pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'diṃ ltaraṃ mkhyen gsum chos can/ khyod kyis 'phags bzhi'i rtogs rigs bsdus pa yin te/ de ltar du yum bar ma las don mthun du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi shes nyan rang gi rtogs rigs su bstan pa/ lam shes byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su bstan pa/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs su bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rgyu mtshan dri ba dang / rgyu mtshan 'god pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcomaṃ ldaṃn ci'i phyir gzhi shes nyan rang gi rtogs rigs yin ce na/ gnyis pa ni/ rabaṃ 'byoraṃ gzhi shes chos can/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs yin te/ gzhi bden pa'i skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs gang zhig lam shes kyi rtogs rigs kyang ma yin/ rnam mkhyen gyi rtogs rigs kyang ma yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rgyu mtshan dri ba dang / rgyu mtshan 'god pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcoṃm ldanaṃ ci'i phyir lam shes byang sems 'phags pa'i rtogs rigs yin ce na/ gnyis pa ni/ raṃb 'byoraṃ de chos can/ de yin te/ theg pa gsum gyi lam gsum shes shing spangs rtogs rdzogs par byed pa dang / rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ rgyu mtshan dri ba dang / rgyu mtshan 'god pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcoṃm ldaṃn ci'i phyir rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rtogs rigs yin ce na/ gnyis pa ni/ raṃb 'byoraṃ de chos can/ de yin te/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ bzhiṃn mkhyen gsum chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i rtogs rigs bsdus te/ de bsdus par brgyad stong pa las gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rgyasaṃ paṃr gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las rgyas pa 'bum las zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa lung gi don bshad pa la gsum ste/ gzhi shes kyi/ lam shes kyi/ rnam mkhyen gyi lung gi don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ gzhi shes chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ dmigs rnam 'bras bu'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ laṃm shesaṃ paṃ lam shes chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ gsum pa ni/ rnaṃm paṃ rnam mkhyen chos can/ chos rtags 'dra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ rgyan chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs ma lus par bstan te/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa gsum char brjod byar bsdus pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum gyi rgyan du gyur pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'di'i mkhyen gsum gyi ming can phal che ba ni gzhung 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo byang sems kyi rgyud kyi skye med gsum rtogs pa'i rtogs pa yin la/ 'bras yum la bzhag pa'i tshe ni sangs rgyas kyi sa la'ang shes par bya'o/

/'di man chad du sa bcad dmigs bsal med pa'i gsum zhes pa rnams mtshams sbyar rtsa ba 'grel pa gsum yin la/ gnyis zhes pa rnams mtshams sbyar ba dang rtsa 'grel phyogs gcig tu bshad pa yin cing / dang gis bar du chod pa'i mtshams gong 'og ni rtsa 'grel sdebs pa'i gzhung gi mgo gnyis yin no/ /rtsa 'grel sbyor ba 'god tshul mi mthun pa rnams la rtsa ba'i sbyor ba ni rang lugs yin pas 'gal bar mi sems so/ /gnyis pa rjod byed bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyeṃ boṃ byams pas rgyan gyi dgos 'grel gyi ngag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rgyan gyi gdul bya rgyan la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod dam snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom bskyed pa'i sgo nas rgyan la 'jug pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ brjod bya ni/ rnaṃm dang rnaṃm sher phyin gyis mdo'i brjod byar gyur pa'i mngon par rtogs pa brgyad chos can/ rgyan gyi brjod bya yin te/ rgyan gyi bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa ni/ brjoṃd paṃr rgyan chos can/ khyod kyi brjod bya rjod byed la thabs thabs byung gi 'brel pa grub ste/ khyod bstan bcos rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ nying dgos ni/ gzhaṃn dang phyiṃ rgyan la brten nas mngon par rtogs pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par mngon sum du rtogs pa chos can/ rgyan gyi nying dgos yin te/ rgyan la brten nas thob pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ dgos pa ni/ bdeṃ dang dgoṃs rgyan la brten nas sher phyin gyi mdo'i don bde blag du rtogs pa de chos can/ khyod rgyan gyi dgos pa yin te/ khyod gang gi ched du rgyan rtsom pa'i ched du bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la gsum ste/ rgyas pa la dad pa la brgyad du phye/ bar pa la dad pa la drug tu bstan/

bsdus pa la dad pa la gsum du bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bsdus don lus rnam bzhag dang / tshigs don yan lag brgyad bshad do/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ bshad bya'i ngag nye bar dgod/ de dag gis bsdus pa'i don/ rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ mgon po byams pas rgyan gyi lus rnam bzhag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rgyan nyan pa pos rtogs sla ba dang / 'chad pa pos bshad sla ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lus mdor bstan/ cung zad phye ste bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul/ dngos po brgyad du phye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sheṃs raṃb byams mgon chos can/ sher phyin yang dag par bshad pa yin te/ sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas mdo ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃm kuṃn rgyan gyi lus chos can/ dngos po brgyad du yod de/ yul mkhyen pa gsum/ yul can sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la brgyad las rnam mkhyen ni/ semaṃs bskyedaṃ byams mgon chos can/ rnam mkhyen yang dag par bshad de/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i sgo nas mdo ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir/ lam shes ni/ moṃg moṃg lam shes dang / mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig sbyar ba gzhan 'gre/ gzhi shes ni/ sheṃs paṃ daṃng / gzhi shes dang / mtshon byed kyi chos dgu sbyar/ rnam kun ni/ rnaṃm paṃ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig sbyar/ rtse sbyor ni/ deṃ yiṃ/ rtse sbyor dang mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad sbyar/ mthar gyis pa ni/ mtharaṃ gyisaṃ mthar gyis sbyor ba dang mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum sbyar/ skad cig ma ni/ skadaṃ cigaṃ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi sbyar/ 'bras bu chos sku ni/ ngoṃ boṃ byams mgon chos can/

'bras bu chos sku yang dag par bshad de/ 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi'i sgo nas mdo ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ laṃ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis chos can/ rgyan gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyan gyi lus dngos po brgyad du bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ tshigaṃ leṃr sems bskyed pa dang / gdams ngag dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad bcu gsum chos can/ rgyan gyi lus cung zad bshad de/ don bdun cu'i rkang grangs tsam du phye nas bstan pa'i phyir/ deṃ ltaraṃ lus rnam bzhag gi tshigs bcad bco lnga chos can/ rgyan gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin te/ rgyan gyi lus dngos po brgyad du bsdus pa dang don bdun cur phye nas bstan pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ bsdusaṃ paṃ'i seṅge bzang po chos can/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong du lus rnam gzhag gi tshig don rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de ltar bkrol na zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tshig don yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab pa'i yul/ nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen/ rgyu lam shes/ rnam par dag byed gzhi shes so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ mgon po byams pas skabs brgyad kyi dang por rnam mkhyen bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rgyan gyi gdul bya 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bsam pa sems bskyed pa/ sbyor ba sgrub pa la 'jug tshul lo/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ ngo bo dmigs pa'i sgo nas bstan/ dmigs pa rgyas bsdus mdo dang sbyar/ rgyas bsdus sgo nas dbye ba bstan/

dbye ba de yi sa mtshams bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos dang / rtsod pa spong ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ seṃms baṃskyed byams mgon chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu'i dang por sems bskyed 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyen don du gnyer bas thog mar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ semaṃs dang saṃngs byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'dun ldan sems bskyed chos can/ theg chen sems bskyed yin te/ theg chen lam zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon ltar na/ de 'dra'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi gtso bo rnam rig 'god do/ /theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ smon pa sems bskyed dang 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ yaṃng daṃg yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces skabs kyi 'dod pa chos can/ sems bskyed min par thal/ sems byung yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags/ grogs ming grogs can la btags pa'o/ /dang po/ bdeṃn moṃd theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ khyod la rgyu gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod rang rgyu gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ de la de'i ming gis btags pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa yod na dge ba'i chos thams cad rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃm paṃ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ khyod la rang gi grogs byang chub don gnyer gyi smon lam gyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod de dang mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir/

de la de'i ming gis btags pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la smon lam dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed skye'o zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni slob dpon sems bskyed gtso sems su 'dod pa'i rtsod lan no/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ yaṃng gaṃng de dang de ni mdo bzhin du zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa byang chub dang gzhan don bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ daṃng rgyan gzhung chos can/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa yang dag par bshad pa yin te/ de'i dmigs pa byang chub dang gzhan don gnyis mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis gnyis kyi sgo nas mdo ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ yum gsum char gyi khungs smos pa/ yum bar ma'i mdo dang sbyar ba/ rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi lung tshig ma smos pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ rgyalaṃ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ gzhan don dang byang chub la dmigs pa yin te/ de la dmigs pa yum gsum char las don mthun du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lung drangs pa/ rtsa ba'i tshig don bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sheṃs raṃb chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ byang chub mdor bstan pa yin te/ byang chub kyi ming tsam smos pa'i phyir/ sbyinaṃ paṃ sbyin pa po dang len pa po la sogs pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir yongs su btang ba med pa'i tshul gyis zhes sogs kyi mdo chos can/ byang chub rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ byang chub kyi ngo bo phar phyin drug du phye nas bshad pa'i phyir/ seṃms caṃn/ byang sems chen po phyogs bcu re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi zhes sogs kyi mdo chos can/

gzhan don mdor bstan pa yin te/ gzhan don gyi thabs ma phye bar bstan pa'i phyir/ seṃr snaṃ ser sna can rnams sbyin pa la 'god par 'dod pas zhes sogs kyi mdo chos can/ gzhan don rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ gzhan don gyi thabs phye nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ngaṃg giṃs rgyan gyi ngag chos can/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa yang dag par brjod pa yin te/ byang chub dang gzhan don gnyis mdo bzhin du rgyas bsdus gnyis gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa yin te/ de ltar du mdo las bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gtsugaṃ laṃg seng bzang chos can/ sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa 'chad pa'i 'grel pa don gsal gyi skabs 'dir rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi lung dngos su ma bris pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'grel pa don gsal tshig mang du dogs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ de yang sa gser zla ba me zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi dbye ba bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ yangaṃ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas nyer gnyis yod de/ byang chub dang gzhan don mdor bsdus pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas gcig byang chub rgyas pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas gsum/ gzhan don rgyas pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas bco brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'duṃn paṃ de chos can/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas nyer gnyis yod de/ de'i sgo nas 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa nas chos kyi sku dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i bar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ saṃ daṃng de chos can/ dpe'i sgo nas nyer gnyis yod de/ dpe'i sgo nas sa lta bu nas sprin lta bu'i bar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

chosaṃ dkaṃr de chos can/ chos mthun gyi sgo nas nyer gnyis yod de/ de'i sgo nas chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos por rung ba nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i bar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaṃr sa gser zla ba me zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis chos can/ sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis bshad de/ dpe'i sgo nas 'dun ldan sems bskyed sogs 'phangs pa'i rgyan tshig yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ deṃ laṃ theg chen gyi sems bskyed chos can/ theg chen las dang po pa'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rjes thob kyi bar du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor ba sgrub pa la 'jug tshul la gsum ste/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa tsam la 'jug tshul/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sgrub pa la 'jug tshul/ de gnyis ka'i thun mong gi chos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyisaṃ te/ gdams ngag bcu spyir bstan/ rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbyeṃ baṃ theg chen gyi sems bskyed kyi dbye ba'i 'og tu theg chen gyi gdams ngag bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byang chub kyi sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas sems bskyed kyi dbye bas 'phangs pa'i yon tan ma thob pa thob pa dang thob zin mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrubaṃ daṃng skabs 'dir bstan gyi theg chen gyi gdams ngag chos can/ rnam pa bcur grangs nges te/ gdams bya'i yul bcur grangs nges pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa dang / sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi chos la 'doms pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byangaṃ chuṃb shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po yum la spyod pas ni byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par mi mthong zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/

sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la brgyad las/ dang po sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la 'doms pa ni/ sdugaṃ bsngalaṃ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen pos gzugs stong pa nyid la brtson na brtson zhes bya'o zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas zhes pa yan chad 'gre sdug bsngal bden pa'i stong nyid dang yul can sher phyir gnyis/ de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bor rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ kunaṃ 'aṃbyung gzugs skye ba'i chos can dang / 'gag pa'i chos can du yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ kun 'byung bden pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas kun 'byung bden pa sngar med gsar du kun 'byung ba sogs kyi spros pa dang bral ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ 'goṃg paṃ shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid de ni mi skye mi 'gag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin/ rnam par byang ba ma yin zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ 'gog bden la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas glo bur dri bral gyi stong nyid gzugs nas byang chub kyi bar gyi spros pa dang bral ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ laṃm laṃ sher phyin la spyod pa na bdag nyid la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya ba'am mi brtson zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ lam bden la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas don dam par phan tshun bsgom bya sgom byed kyi spros pa dang bral ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rten la 'doms pa ni/ sangs rgyas de sher phyin la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs la thaṃms cad mkhyen pa nyid kyisaṃ sbyor bar mi byed do zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub dbyings dang ye shes su zhen pa bkag pa sogs kyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ choṃs laṃ de sher phyin la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sbyor ro zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ chos dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas gzhi gnyen rnam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ dgeṃ 'duṃn/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig sher phyin gyi gnas pa 'dis gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de gang nas shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes pa lags/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas ni gang du skye bar 'gyur zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams rang bzhin gyi skye ba med pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sgrub pa khyad bar du 'gro ba'i rgyu la 'doms pa ni/ brtsonaṃ 'aṃgrus/ bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen po'i lus kyi kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa dang zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo'i gnyen por lus sogs ngo bo nyid med par nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgrub pa phyir mi ldog par 'gro ba'i rgyu la 'doms pa ni/ duṃs yuṃn gzugs la rlom sems med pa dang zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/

yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas sgyid lug pa'i le lo'i gnyen por gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la bden par rlom pa med pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa sgrub pa theg pa gzhan gyis mi 'gro ba'i rgyu la 'doms pa ni/ phyogaṃs baṃcu shā ri'i bu byang sems chen po ye shes gang dag ldan pas shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas sems zhum pa'i le lo'i gnyen por chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa sgrub pa gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog par 'gro ba'i rgyu la 'doms pa ni/ sha'iṃ dngaṃ shā ri'i bu byang sems chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad brgya mthong ba yod de zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ spyan lnga la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas spyan lnga yul yul can rnams de bzhin nyid du gcig pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa sgrub pa rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i rgyu la 'doms pa ni/ rdzuṃ 'phruṃl de ni sa chen po 'di'ang rab tu g.yo bar byed do/ /gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur ro zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ mngon shes drug la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas mngon shes drug gzod ma nas zhi ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu la 'doms pa ni/ mthoṃng baṃ'i rab 'byor khyod byang sems chen po rnams la sher phyin las brtsams te spobs pa skyed cig zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/

mthong lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas mthong spang gi gnyen por mthong lam nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ 'duṃs byasaṃ rab 'byor 'dus byas kyi dbyings med par 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings gdags par mi nus so zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ sgo nas sgom spang gi gnyen por sgom lam nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ theg chen gyi gdams ngag chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcur grangs nges te/ khyod kyi gdams bya'i yul bcu po des rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ khyod kyi gdams bya'i yul de la sgrub pa'i rnam pa nas/ sgrub pa mthar thug par 'gro ba'i rgyu'i bar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtogs dka' ba bye brag du bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ dgeṃ 'aṃdun dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rab dbye bde blag du rtogs pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi ming can dang / rang rgyal gyi dge 'dun gyi ming can no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ zhugs pa'i 'bras gnas tsam po'i/ 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi ming can no/ /dang po ni/ dbaṃng poṃ/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ khyod la zhugs pa'i ming can gnyis yod de/ khyod la dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / chos kyi rjes 'brang gi ming can gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ daṃd daṃng de chos can/ khyod la 'bras gnas tsam po'i ming can drug tu yod de/ khyod la rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po dad mos mthong thob gnyis kyi ming can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ riṃgs naṃs de chos can/ khyod la 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi ming can bcu gcig yod de/ khyod la rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can gcig phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gcig phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can dgu'i ming can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la phyi ma dgu po de yod de/ khyod la 'da' ba bzhi/ 'og min mthar thug 'gro/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro/ gzugs kyi chags bcom/ mthong chos zhi/ lus mngon byed kyi ming can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'di dag rtsa ba dang / nyi snang gi dgongs pa yin tshul dogs gcod dang bcas pa ngag las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bseṃ ruṃ de chos can/ bse ru lta bu'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos mi bzhugs pa'i zhing khams su sgra med lus kyis chos ston pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi dang / rang rgyal gyi dge 'dun gyi ming can no/ /dang po la zung bzhi las/ dang po rgyun zhugs kyi skor la zhugs pa ni/ 'chaṃd paṃr mthong lam skad cig dang po bco lnga la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ mthong spangs spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ de la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rtul chos can/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang gi ming gis gdags su rung ste/ dad pa lhag pas 'bras bu'i rjes su sbyong ba'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ de la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gi ming gis gdags su rung ste/ shes rab lhag pas 'bras bu'i ched du sbyor ba'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras gnas la tsam po ni/ rgyunaṃ duṃ/ sngar sgom spang ma spangs pa'i sems kyi skad cig bcu drug pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/

mthong spangs spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par can ni/ deṃ nyidaṃ 'dod pa'i lha'i skye ba ris mthun gnyis sam gsum blangs nas sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems chos can/ lha'i rigs nas rigs skye'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ de dang skye ba len tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zung gnyis pa la zhugs pa ni/ dbangaṃ poṃ/ 'dod pa'i sgom spang lnga pa spangs nas drug pa spong ba la brtson pa'i byang sems chos can/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs drug pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras gnas la tsam po ni/ lanaṃ gciṃg 'dod pa'i sgom spangs drug pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ lan gcig phyir 'ong gi ming gis gdags su rung ste/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs drug pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par can ni/ deṃ nyidaṃ 'dod pa khams su skye ba lan gcig blangs nas sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems chos can/ bar chad gcig pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ de dang skye ba len tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zung gsum pa la zhugs pa ni/ sngaṃ maṃ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs dgu pa spong ba la brtson pa'i byang sems chos can/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs dgu pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyis 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras gnas la tsam po ni ma gsungs la/ khyad par can la 'da' ba zhi/ gong 'pho gsum/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro gnyis te tshan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyiraṃ miṃ/ gzugs kyi bar dor sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa dang / gzugs su skyes tsam nas sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa dang /

gzugs su skyes nas lam la 'bad rtsol dang bcas te sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa dang / lam la 'bad rtsol med par sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems bzhi po chos can/ rim pa ltar bar 'da' ba dang / skyes 'da' ba dang / mngon par 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba dang / mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' ba'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ de dag dang skye ba len tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ nyidaṃ tshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar du skyes nas zhing sna tshogs su sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems chos can/ 'og min mthar thug 'gro'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ de dang skye ba len tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum las/ phyi ma tshangs ris su skyes te/ bar gyi gnas gzhan rnams dor ba 'og min du sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa dang / tshangs ris nas gtsang ma'i 'og ma gsum gang rung du skyes nas bar gyi gnas gzhan rnams brgal te/ 'og min du skyes nas sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa dang / tshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar du rim pa bzhin du skyes nas zhing sna tshogs su sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems chos can/ rim pa ltar 'phar ba dang / phyed du 'phar ba dang / gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ de dag dang skye ba len tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ nyidaṃ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i byang sems chos can/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ bzhed na gzugs med bzhi la 'jug nus pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis las/ mthong ba'i chos la byang chub mngon du byed pa'i byang sems chos can/ mthong chos bzhi'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ de dang byang chub thob tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rnam thar brgyad kyi ting nge 'dzin lus kyis mngon sum du byed pa'i byang sems chos can/ lus mngon byed kyi ming gis gdags su rung ste/

de dang yon tan thob tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zung bzhi pa la zhugs pa ni/ dgraṃ bcoṃm srid rtse'i sgom spangs dgu pa spong ba la brtson pa'i byang sems chos can/ dgra bcom zhugs pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ste/ khams gsum gyi sgom spangs spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ raṃng saṃngs rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi ming can rnams mdo las skye ba len tshul gyi chos mthun 'ba' zhig gsungs pas skye ba len tshul gsungs pa'i phyir zhes pa 'ba' zhig gis chog mod kyi/ 'dir zhugs pa dang / 'bras gnas tsam po rnams spangs pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa ni nyi snang gi rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /gnyis pa phyir mi ldog pa'i sgrub pa la bzhi ste/ sgrub pa skyes pa'i gnas skabs/ sgrub pa'i rten/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ laṃs daṃng byams mgon chos can/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag gi 'og tu theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ las dang po pa theg chen gyi gdams ngag thob pa las/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dmiṃgs paṃ rten dang / ngo bo dang / ldan pa dang / dbye ba'i khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ nyan rang gi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags te/ de las dmigs pa dang / rnam pa dang / rgyu dang / yongs 'dzin bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos kyi don dang / zhar las byung ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul dang / khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gang dang / gang gis dang / gang las khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/

rgyu dang / 'byung ba'i dus dang / ngo bo dang / dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ byangaṃ chubaṃ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ khyod kyi nye rgyu yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can gyi dad sogs de khyod kyi nye rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i 'oṃg tuṃ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ khyod 'byung ba'i dus yod de/ khyod theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can gyi dad sogs rdzogs pa'i 'og tu 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdeṃn paṃ theg chen gyi drod sogs bzhi po chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi ngo bo yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang / dmigs rnam rjes su mthun pa'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ chuṃng nguṃ theg chen gyi drod sogs bzhi po chos can/ re re la gsum gsum yod de/ re re la chung 'bring chen po gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'chadaṃ paṃr theg chen gyi sbyor lam mnyam gzhag drod sogs bzhi chos can/ khyad chos lnga dang ldan te/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug la dmigs pa dang / mngon zhen med pa sogs kyi rnam par zhugs pa dang / theg pa gsum char rtogs pa'i mthong lam gyi rgyu dang / theg chen gyi yongs 'dzin gyis yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rnam rtog bzhi dang 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyanaṃ thosaṃ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ nyan rang gi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags te/ khyad chos lnga ldan gyi byang sems kyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ daṃg nyan rang gi sbyor lam chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam las dman te/ khyod chos lnga dang bral ba'i sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa zhar las byung ba la gsum ste/ dmigs tshul sna tshogs su bstan pa/ rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ lung gzhan dang 'gal ba spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ byangaṃ chuṃb byang sems kyi nges 'byed cha mthun chos can/

bden bzhi'i dngos po la dmigs tshul sna tshogs kyis dmigs te/ de la rgyu 'bras ngo bo chos nyid sogs kyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gis kyang bden bzhi la dmigs te/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs kyi bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mdoṃr bsdusaṃ rnam pa gzhan gyis dmigs tshul brjod dgos so zhe na/ seng bzang chos can/ rnam pa gzhan gyis dmigs tshul skabs 'dir rgyas par ma brjod de/ skabs 'dir dmigs tshul mdor bsdus pa tsam brjod par 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gaṃng giṃs rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma'i dmigs tshul mi 'thad de/ mdzod las/ dri med bcu drug gzhan rnam med/ /ces bshad pas so she na/ theg pa chen po chos can/ khyod kyi lugs kyis theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi dmigs rnam bzhag pa la/ theg pa gzhan gyi sun 'byin brjod par mi bya ste/ khyod kyi de theg pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum rgyas par bshad/ ldan pa rnam rtog rgyas par bshad/ yongs 'dzin dge bshes rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dri ba'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ chos can brjod pa chad pa'i rtsod spang ngo / /dang po ni/ dmiṃgs paṃ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa zhes sogs tshigs bcad bdun gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi dmigs rnam gyi khyad par bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la drod sogs bzhi las/ dang po drod la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dmiṃgs dang deṃ byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod chung ngu chos can/ theg dman gyi drod chung ngu las khyad par du 'phags te/ de las dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ 'og ma kun la 'gre'o/

/gzugs dang 'bringaṃ drod 'bring dang sbyar ro/ /gnaṃs dang cheṃn drod chen po dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam dang po chos can/ dro bar gyur pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me skye ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtse mo la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzugs dang chungaṃ rtse mo chung ngu dang sbyar ro/ /deṃ rnaṃms dang 'bringaṃ rtse mo 'bring dang sbyar ro/ /deṃ daṃg dang cheṃn rtse mo chen po dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam gnyis pa chos can/ rtse mor gyur pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba mi mthun phyogs kyis g.yo ba rnams kyi rtse mo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bzod pa la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzuṃgs dang chuṃng / bzod pa chung ngu sbyar ro/ /deṃ dang 'bringaṃ bzod pa 'bring dang sbyar ro/ /deṃ daṃg dang chenaṃ bzod pa chen po dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam gsum pa chos can/ bzod par gyur pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos chen po skye med kyi don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa chos mchog la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ tingaṃ dang chuṃng chos mchog chung ngu dang sbyar ro/ /luṃng dang 'briṃng chos mchog 'bring dang sbyar ro/ /gsumaṃ dang chenaṃ chos mchog chen po dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi pa chos can/ chos mchog ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

'jig rten pa'i chos thams cad kyi mchog yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la rtsod pa ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ bden pa'i rten can/ zhes pas dmigs rnam dang po bden pa'i rten can du bstan pa ltar/ dmigs rnam lhag ma rnams kyang bden pa'i rten can du bstan dgos pa las ma bstan par dmigs rnam gyi chos 'ba' zhig brjod pas dmigs rnam lhag ma rnams ston pa'i gzhung la thos bsam byas kyang bden bzhi'i don mi rtogs par 'gyur ro zhe na/ lan la gnyis te/ sgra gnyis brjod bya tha dad med pas chos can go ba'i lan/ don gyi shugs kyis chos can go ba'i lan no/ /dang po ni/ dmiṃgs paṃ dmigs rnam phyi ma rnams ston pa'i rgyan gzhung chos can/ khyod la brten nas chos can bden bzhi mi rtogs pa'i skyon med de/ khyod kyis bden bzhi'i chos dmigs rnam brjod pa gang zhig chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis don gcig nyid khyad par gzhan spong mi spong gi tshul gyis brjod pa ma gtogs par brjod bya'i don la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃm paṃ dmigs rnam phyi ma rnams bden bzhi'i rten can du ma bstan pas bden bzhi'i chos min par 'gyur ro zhe na/ dmigs rnam phyi ma rnams chos can/ bden bzhi'i chos ma yin pa'i skyon med de/ dmigs rnam dang po'i chos can bden bzhi de khyod kyi chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ldan pa rnam rtog rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ gzhung gi don 'byed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnaṃm paṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ ldan tshul gyis don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzung rtog mdor bstan/ 'dzin rtog mdor bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhiṃ dang gzuṃng gzung rtog chos can/ gnyis yod de/ gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung bar rtog pa dang / gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung bar rtog pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

gzung rtog gnyis po chos can/ rnam pa dgu dgur yod de/ yul dgu dgu yod pa'i dbye bas phye ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdzaṃs dang gaṃng 'dzin rtog chos can/ gnyis yod de/ gang zag rdzas su yod pa la dmigs pa dang / skyes bu btags par yod pa la dmigs pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dzin rtog gnyis po chos can/ chos rtags gzung rtog gi skabs dang 'dra/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gzung rtog rgyas par bshad pa/ 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzhi dang / gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kuṃn ma rig pa la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung bar rtog pa yin te/ rang yul dor bya la dmigs nas dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po nas rnam dag skye byed sogs kyi bar brgyad po re re bzhin chos can du bzung nas chos rtags 'dra'o/ /de la dang po brgyad rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog yin la/ phyi ma ni byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i gzung rtog ste/ 'di la skabs lnga par ldog pa gzung rtog dgur phye nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnyenaṃ rnam byang gi phung po la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung bar rtog pa yin te/ rang yul blang bya la dmigs nas blang bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ rnam byang skye ba'i sgo nas gzung ste mi slob pa'i lam la blang bya'i bzung bar rtog pa'i bar brgyad po re re bzhin chos can du bzung nas chos rtags 'dra'o/ /de la gzung rtog dang po bzhi dang / phyi ma gsum ni rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i rnam byang gzung rtog yin la/

bar pa gnyis ni byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i gzung rtog ste/ 'di la skabs lnga par 'jug pa gzung rtog dgur phye nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa rgyas par bshad/ btags 'dzin rtog pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gaṃng bdag rang dbang can la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo de chos can/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa yin te/ rang yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gcig bu'i bdag nas bzung ste/ mi slob lam gyi rten la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i bar brgyad po re re bzhin chos can du bzung nas chos rtags 'dra'o/ /de la 'dzin rtog dang po bzhi ni gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ste nyan thos kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyon sgrib yin la/ phyi ma lnga ni chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ste/ 'di la skabs lnga par mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dgur phye nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyesaṃ gang zag btags yod kyi gdags gzhi'i phung po la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ btags 'dzin rtog pa yin te/ rang yul btags yod kyi 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gang zag btags yod kyi gdags gzhi sems bskyed nas bzung ste mi slob pa'i lam la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo'i bar brgyad po re re bzhin chos can du bzung nas chos rtags 'dra'o/ /'di dag ni byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs kho na ste/ nyan rang gis btags 'dzin rtog pa spang byar mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la btags chos dgu la btags yod du 'dzin pa ni gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa yin zhing /

gdags gzhi dgu la btags yod du 'dzin pa ni chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa ste/ skabs lnga par mthong spangs btags 'dzin rtog pa dgur phye nas gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ deṃ ci skad bshad pa'i rtog pa bzhi po chos can/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi la grangs bzhin du ldan pa yin te/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun rjes thob bzhi'i ngo bor grangs bzhin du ldan pa'i phyir/ shugs bstan dgag rtog dang mnyam gzhag bzhi'i ldan tshul yang sbyar ro/ /gsum pa yongs 'dzin dge bshes rgyas par bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshiṃg nges 'byed cha mthun mdor bstan du yongs 'dzin rtog pa'i gong du gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mdor bstan gyi tshigs bcad sbyar bde ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ nges 'byed cha mthun rgyas bshad du yongs 'dzin rtog pa'i mjug thogs su gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ yongs 'dzin gyi stobs kyis rtog pa khyad chos su shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ seṃms 'phags pa ltar na byang sems sbyor lam pa chos can/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs rgyun ldan du bsgoms kyang theg dman du mi ltung ste/ phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin khyad par can gnyis kyis theg chen du yongs su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ seṃms khyad par gsum ldan gyi mchog gi sprul sku chos can/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i yongs 'dzin yin te/ de la theg chen gyi chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rten la gnyis te/ rigs kyi dbye ba/ rigs la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrub byams mgon chos can/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi 'og du sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ci skad bshad pa'i rten chos sgrub pa dang ldan pa la nges 'byed cha mthun dang mthong lam sogs gzhan yang 'byung ba'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ rtogaṃs sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi rten du 'gyur ba'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin te/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ go rim nges pa/ grangs nges pa/ rigs su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ rigs theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod kyi rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ de bzhin sbyor lam phyi ma gsum dang / theg chen gyi mthong lam dang / sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam gyi rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can du bzung nas sbyor ba drug go /deṃ'i sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam gyi rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ khyod la ldog pa'i sgo nas gnyen po'i sgrub pa dang / spang ba'i sgrub pa gnyis su dbyer rung ste/ khyod skye ba dang / khyod kyi ngos skal gyi spang bya 'gag pa dus mnyam/ khyod skyes pa dang / khyod kyi ngo skal gyi spang bya 'gags pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ dper na rkun po phyung ba dang / sgo 'phar bcad pa ltar ro/ /spang ba'i sgrub pa rnam grol lam 'jog na spong ba dang / spangs pa khyad med du thal bas bar chad med lam la bzhag pa gzhung gi dgongs pa ste/ sa dang po nas kyang bzhag tu rung bar mngon no/ /deṃ'i sa brgyad pa'i rnam grol lam gyi rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ deṃ'i sa brgyad pa'i khyad par lam gyi rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ deṃ'i sa dgu pa'i rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ deṃ'i sa bcu pa'i rjes thob kyi rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ deṃ'i sa bcu rgyun mtha'i sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/

chos rtags 'dra/ 'diṃ sgrub pa bcu gsum chos can/ go rim bzhin du bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phar cher rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃs sgrub pa bcu gsum chos can/ khyod kyis rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ khyod kyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar gyi sgrub pa thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sgrubaṃ sgrub pa bcu gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa bcu gsum po chos can/ khyod kyi sems kyi chos dbyings kho na skabs 'dir rigs su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de kho na stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub pa'i rten yin pa'i phyir/ kho na'i don 'di yin par mngon no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ gaṃl chos dbyings kho na 'phags pa'i chos rtogs pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum po kho na sangs rgyas kyi rigs can yin na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs la gnas par thal/ chos dbyings sems can thams cad la spyir gnas pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs tha dad pa gsum du dbyer mi rung bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'thad pa'i sgo nas rigs su 'jog pa dang / dpe'i sgo nas dbye ba 'thad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ jiṃ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ rgyu'i sgo nas rigs su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg pa gsum gyi sgrub pas bdag med gsum rtogs pa'i rim gyis khyod la ji ltar dmigs pa ltar 'phags chos so sor thob pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngaṃ chos dbyings la rigs tha dad pa gsum du dbyer mi rung bar thal ba la/ dpe'i sgo nas lan btab pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ lan go sla ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rteṃn dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings chos can/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med kyang / theg pa gsum gyi rigs tha dad pa gsum du dbyer rung ste/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med kyang theg pa gsum gyi sgrub pa'i rten gzhi so sor byed du rung ba'i chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rdza'i snod gsum bcud kyi sgo nas sbrang rtsi dang li kha ra la sogs pa'i snod kyi dbye ba rung ba bzhin no/ /'di dag la 'phags pas rtsod lan tshan pa gnyis su gsungs pa'i tshul ni gzhan du bshad zin to// //gsum pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ jiṃ skaṃd sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dmiṃgs paṃ chos thams cad chos can/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ theg chen sgrub pas sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ so so'i ngo bo/ go rim nges pa/ grangs nges pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ reṃ shiṃg dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum po chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ de'iṃ 'oṃg so skye'i rgyud kyi phung po lnga sogs brgyad chos can du bzung nas/ chos rtags 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ dmigs pa bcu gcig chos can/ khyod go rim bzhin du bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyi go rim de rtogs pa'i go rim yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dmiṃgs paṃ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa chos can/ khyod la bcu gcig tu grangs nges te/ khyod la spyi gsum dang / bye brag brgyad rnams su nges pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba la gsum las/ dang po ni/ dmiṃgs paṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ seṃms caṃn sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chen po gsum po chos can/ theg chen bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba yin te/

gang gis dbang du byas nas theg chen gyi sgrub pa byed par 'gyur ba'i theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed chos can/ sems chen po yin te/ rang gang gis 'thob pa'i sems can thams cad sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sa'i spang ba chos can/ spang ba chen po yin te/ rtags gzhan 'dra ba las spang ba yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sa'i bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i rtogs pa de chos can/ rtogs pa chen po yin te/ rtags gzhan 'dra ba las rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de gnyis ka'i thun mong gi chos bshad pa la gsum ste/ dri ba'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ lan gyi sgo nas ngo bo ngos bzung / so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ yul mkhyen gsum gyi sgrub pa/ yul can sbyor ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thaṃms cadaṃ mkhyen gsum la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i lta ba chos can/ yul mkhyen gsum gyi sgrub pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum la thob bya thob byed blang dor bya ba'i yan lag tu thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyir dge ba'i chos kyi rten can du gyur pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams tshogs lam phal pa'i gnas skabs kho na na yod/ gnyis pa ni/ rnamaṃ mkhyen gsum la thos bsam rab tu gyur pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i lta ba chos can/ yul can sbyor ba'i sgrub pa yin te/ mngon rtogs drug po re re zhing pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rten can du bsgrub pa'i tshul la mkhas pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ spyi sgrub pa dang bye brag bsgrub pa zhes pa'i tha snyad sbyar na yang 'dra'o/

/gsum pa la bzhi ste/ bsam pas go bgos pa go cha'i sgrub pa/ sbyor bas tshul bzhin du zhugs pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ 'bras bu la mngon du phyogs pa tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ 'bras bu 'byin pa la zhugs pa nges 'byung sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ sgrub pa bzhi'i nang nas dang por go sgrub 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ go sgrub de thog mar bsam pas go bgos pa'i brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa bzhi po chos can/ khyod kyi ma mtha'i sa mtshams so sor yod de/ khyod kyi ma mtha'i sa mtshams rim pa ltar/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam dang / sbyor lam drod dang / chos mchog chen po dang / sa brgyad pa nas yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ daṃg byang sems tshogs lam pa'i lta ba chos can/ go cha'i sgrub pa yin te/ phar phyin re re zhing phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i bsam pas go bgos pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sbyin pa'i go cha bshad pa/ de tshul gzhan la bsgre ba'o/ /dang po ni/ chosaṃ kyi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i lta ba chos can/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub yin te/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa la sogs 'gre/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ bzhiṃn chos can snga ma bzung nas tshul khrims kyi go sgrub yin te/ sogs lnga 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ go sgrub chos can khyod la rgyas par phye na sum cu rtsa drug yod kyang / bsdu na drug tu 'dus te/ khyod la rgyas par phye na sbyin sogs re re la drug drug du dbyer yod kyang / bsdu na bsdu bya drug drug sdud byed re rer 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /'di yang sbyin pa'i bsdu bya drug sbyin par chos mthun zhes pa ni mdo sde rgyan gyi dgongs pa yin pas 'gog du mi rung ngo /

/gnyis pa 'jug sgrub la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs te/ byams mgon chos can/ go sgrub kyi 'og tu 'jug sgrub 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bsam pas go bgos pa las sbyor bas theg chen la 'jug pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsaṃm dang bsaṃm byang sems sbyor lam pa'i brtson 'grus chos can/ 'jug sgrub yin te/ rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i theg chen sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis rnam par gnon pa'i byang sems kyi nyams len yin pa'i phyir/ dgu po so sor phral na bsam gtan gzugs med la 'jug pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i brtson 'grus chos can/ bsam gtan gzugs med la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa yin te/ bsam gtan gzugs med sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis rnam par gnon pa'i nyams len yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs 'god do/ /gsum pa tshogs sgrub la gnyis te/ tshogs bcu bdun spyir bstan pa dang / rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ brtseṃ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun chos can/ khyod rim bzhin du bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyi bsgrub bya tshogs bcu bdun po rim can du 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ tshogs kyi dbye ba dang / tshogs sgrub tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ snyingaṃ tshogs chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcu bdun yod de/ khyod la theg pa la gnas nas go cha chen po bgos par 'jog byed bcu/ theg pa rang gi ngo bo bdun rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ miṃ dmiṃgs chos mchog chen po yan chad kyi tshogs bcu bdun po chos can/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa yin te/ rang 'bras dri ma gdod ma nas zad skye med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang chub 'byin pa'i rgyu tshogs nus pa mthu can yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la gsum ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ yul can ye shes bshad pa dang / yul stong nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ tshogs sgrub kyi skabs 'dir stong nyid nyi shu ston pa'i mdo tshig chos can/ khyod kyis sbas don yul can ye shes nyi shu bstan pa yin te/ khyod kyis de ma bstan na khyod kyis mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ma bstan dgos pa gang zhig khyod kyis mngon rtogs kyi rim pa bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir stong nyid chos can/ khyod la nyi shu yod de/ khyod kyi stong gzhi'i chos can nyi shu po rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la nyi shur phye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos so/ /dang po ni/ saṃ'i sa'i tshogs la bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa gsum gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sa'i yongs sbyong bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rgyu sa'i yongs sbyong dang / 'bras bu sa'i ngo bo'o/ /dang po la dgu las/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong ni/ yoṃngs dang jiṃ sa dang po'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas yongs sbyong gi chos bcu yongs su sbyong ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sa dang po'i skyon zad cing yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas rdzogs par 'thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ sa dang po'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi yongs sbyong gi chos bcu po ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i nyams len de chos can/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong yin te/ sa dang po'i mnyam gzhag gi skabs su sa'i ngo bo thob pa de skyon dang yon tan yongs su sbyong ba'i sgo nas rdzogs par byed pa'i sa dang po'i nyams len yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis po 'di 'og ma kun la bsgre'o/ /sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ tshulaṃ dang sdomaṃ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi yongs sbyong gi chos brgyad po ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong ba chos can sogs 'gre'o/ /sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ thoṃs dang daṃm sa gsum pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis yongs sbyong gi chos lnga po ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong ba chos can sogs 'gre'o/ /sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ naṃgs dang dgoṃn sa bzhi pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis yongs sbyong gi chos bcu po ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong ba chos can sogs 'gre'o/ /sa lnga pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ 'driṃs dang rnyeṃd yongs sbyong gi chos bcu sbyar gzhan 'gre/ sa drug pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ sbyinaṃ dang phaṃ yongs sbyong gi chos bcu gnyis zhes sbyar gzhan 'gre/ sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong la gnyis te/ spang bya spangs pa dang / gnyen po rdzogs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdaṃg dang bdaṃg sa bdun pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis bdag tu lta ba sogs spang bya nyi shu bkag nas sgom pa chos can sogs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ doṃn gyiṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃm dang rnamaṃ sa bdun pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa sogs gnyen po nyi shu ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong ba chos can sogs 'gre'o/ /sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ seṃms dang seṃms yongs sbyong gi chos brgyad po zhes sbyar gzhan 'gre/ sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyongs ni/ smonaṃ dang smoṃn yongs sbyong gi chos bcu gnyis zhes sbyar gzhan 'gre/ gnyis pa 'bras bu sa'i mtshan nyid la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyu'iṃ sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa'i skabs 'dir chos can/

sa bcu pa yongs sbyong gi sgo nas ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bcu pa sa 'og ma'i rtogs rigs 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ saṃ sa bcu pa'i ye shes chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dman pa sa brgyad dang / byang sems kyi sa dgu gcig tu byas pa rnams las 'das pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'das sa sa dgu ngos bzung ba dang / 'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /dang po ni/ nyanaṃ thoṃs sa bcu pa'i ye shes gang las 'das pa'i sa de chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ khyod la nyan thos kyi sa bdun/ rang rgyal gyi sa gcig byang sems kyi sa dgu gcig tu byas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ saṃ daṃgu sogs la rtsa ba'i ngag 'don 'god/ gsum pa gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag du bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyenaṃ poṃ'i sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mthoṃng dang gzuṃngs byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub yin te/ rang gi ngos skal gyi mthong spangs bzhi'i gnyen por gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ sgom spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub yin te/ rang gi ngos skal gyi sgom spangs bzhi'i gnyen por gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa nges 'byung sgrub pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ chedaṃ dang chedaṃ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin te/ rang gi nges par 'byung sa brgyad du bar chad med par nges par 'byung bar byed pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ so sor sbyar na de chos can/ ched du bya ba'i nges 'byung sgrub pa yin te/ rang gi nges par 'byung sa ched du bya ba chen po gsum du bar chad med par nges par 'byung ba'i zhes sogs brgyad 'god do/

/gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni sheṃs raṃb sogs so// //gnyis pa rgyu lam shes la gsum ste/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ byams mgon chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'og tu lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyen de rang rgyu lam shes med par mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang / yan lag can gyi lam shes so/ /dang po la gnyis las/ rtsa ba ni/ lhaṃ rnamaṃs lam shes chos can/ khyod kyi yan lag de la lngar yod de/ khyod kyi rten gyi yan lag gsum/ rang bzhin gyi yan lag gcig byed las kyi yan lag gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa la gsum ste/ rten gyi yan lag rang bzhin gyi yan lag byed las kyi yan lag go /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos su skye ba'i rten dang / brgyud nas skye ba'i rten no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'gal rkyen bral ba'i rten dang / mthun rkyen tshang ba'i rten no/ /dang po ni/ laṃm shesaṃ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis lha la sogs pa'i rnam smin gyi 'od mog mog por mdzad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ lam shes dngos su skye rung gi rten sgrub pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ ngaṃ rgyalaṃ de'i 'od kyi che ba ston pa'i tshig zur chos can/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i rten brjod pa yin te/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i rten la nga rgyal dang bral ba dgos par bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ yaṃng lam shes chos can/ khyod dngos su skye ba'i yul so sor nges pa yin te/ khyod dngos su skye ba'i rten la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theṃg paṃ lam shes dngos su mi skye ba'i rten byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ma tshang ba'i nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang / nga rgyal dang bral ba ma tshang ba'i phyi rol pa'i chags bral sogs chos can/

lam shes bsgom par bya ba yin pas khyab ste/ khyod sogs skye bo thams cad sangs rgya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gal te nyan rang lhag med du mya ngan las 'das nas theg chen gyi lam du mi 'jug pas gtan tshigs ma grub bo zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/ mthar thug theg pa gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byangaṃ chuṃb byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud nyid kyi lam shes chos can/ nyon mongs pa'i ming can 'dod sred ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rang bzhin can yin te/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba len pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ'i 'oṃg lam shes chos can/ byed las khyad par can dang ldan te/ rang don rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa dang / gzhan don sems can 'khor du ma sdus pa bsdud par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yan lag can gyi lam shes la gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi/ rang rgyal gyi/ byang sems kyi lam shes so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lam shes dngos dang / rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ lam shes kyi yan lag bshad zin pa'i 'og tu shes bya nyan thos kyi lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam shes kyi skabs su theg pa gsum gyi lam rdzogs par shes dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ laṃm sheṃs byang sems kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin te/ bden bzhi'i steng gi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren par byed pa'i byang 'phags kyi mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sa dang po'i rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa chos can/

yang de yin te/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ shes bya'i lam gyi rnam pa/ de ji ltar shes pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dor bya'i rnam pa dang / blang bya'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sdug kun so so ba'i rnam pa dang / sdug kun thun mong ba'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa dang / kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ khyod la ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa gnyis/ rnam grangs kyi rnam pa gnyis rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kuṃn 'byungaṃ kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ khyod la 'gog pa'i rnam grangs kyi rnam pa/ nad kyi rnam pa sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yiṃd 'byungaṃ sdug kun thun mong ba'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod la bdun yod de/ khyod la yid 'byung ba'i rnam pa gnyis/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa gnyis/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa dang / lam bden gyi rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'goṃg paṃ'i 'gog bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ khyod la bdun yod de/ khyod la 'gog pa'i rnam grangs kyi rnam pa bdag med pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa zhi ba dang / gya nom pa'i rnam grangs kyi rnam pa dben pa dang / nges 'byung gi rnam grangs kyi rnam pa bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ laṃm gyiṃ lam bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ khyod la ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa lam sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ngoṃ boṃ sogs te/ rtsa ba'i ngag don gnyis 'god/ gnyis pa rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la gnyis las/

dang po ni/ bdeṃn paṃ byams mgon chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam shes kyi 'og tu de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de de med par mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phaṃgs dang gzuṃgs nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs sgom par byed pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes de chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan te/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa stong pa nyid rnams phan tshun dbyer med pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ dang gzuṃgs de sgom pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam rtse mo chos can/ chos 'dra/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa gzugs sogs mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ dang deṃ de sgom pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam bzod pa chos can/ chos 'dra/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa rtag mi rtag sogs su gnas pa bkag pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ saṃ dang gaṃng de sgom pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ chos 'dra/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa sa bcu la mi gnas pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la gnyis te/ shes bya'i lam gyi rnam bzhag rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'bras bu'i khyad par byed chos/ rgyu lam gyi ngo bo'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos dang rtsod pa spong ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyanaṃ nyan thos kyi lam gyi mjug thogs su shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam 'chad par rigs kyang thog mar 'bras bu rang rgyal gyi ye shes kyi khyad par 'chad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'bras bu rang rgyal gyi ye shes kyi khyad par rtogs pa'i sgo nas rgyu lam gyi khyad par rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis las/

dang po ni/ raṃng dang raṃng bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ nyan thos las lam bgrod tshul gyis khyad par 'phags te/ 'dod pa khams kyi srid pa tha ma pa'i rten la slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma ltos par rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byas pa'i mi slob lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgraraṃ de chos can/ nyan thos las chos ston tshul gyis khyad par 'phags te/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing khams su sgra med lus kyis chos ston pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gong gi luṃng laṃs 'dod pa khams kyi srid pa tha ma pa'i rten la rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byas pa dang / gdul bya la sgra med lus kyis chos ston na/ nyan thos las khyad par du 'phags pas khyab ste/ de gnyis nyan thos la med par lung las bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yaṃng ciṃ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas chos can/ chos ston par mi 'thad par thal/ chos ston pa'i sgra med pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃng dang rnamaṃ de chos can/ sgra med kyang chos ston pa mi 'gal te/ sngon gyi smon lam la sogs pa'i mthus sgra med kyang lus kyi sgo nas gdul bya'i rgyud la bden bzhi sogs kyi rnam pa skyed nus pa'i phyir/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas chos can/ sgra med du chos ston par gyur cig ces sngon smon lam btab pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshig tu brjod pa'i kun slong gi rtog dpyod kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyud 'khrug par byed par dgongs nas sngon smon lam de ltar btab pa'i phyir/ dper na byang chub sems dpas sgra med du chos ston pas 'dul ba'i don du sngon smon lam de ltar btab pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ 'bras bu rang rgyal gyi ye shes kyi khyad par bshad zin pa'i 'og tu rgyu lam gyi khyad par 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

'bras bu la khyad par yod na rgyu la khyad par yod pa rigs pa'i tshul yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzuṃngs dang raṃng shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags te/ gzung rtog spong ba'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi lam las rtogs rigs kyi sgo nas dman te/ 'dzin rtog mi spong ba'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rten gyi khyad par dang ldan te/ ci skad bshad pa'i rtog rigs gnyis kyi rten chos dbyings dang ldan pa'i phyir/ yul can lam shes kyi sbyor ba gnyis paṃ snga ma la bsgres te 'god par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ngeṃs sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ btagaṃs dang gzugs rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs sgom par byed pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes de chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan te/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa ming du btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar ston pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ rtseṃ dang gzuṃgs de 'dra'i rtse mo'i ye shes chos can/ chos 'dra/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa don dam par 'phel 'grib med pa sogs kyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ nangaṃ dang ngoṃ de 'dra'i bzod pa'i ye shes chos can/ chos 'dra/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa nang stong pa nyid la sogs pas gzugs sogs mi 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gzuṃgs dang gzuṃgs de 'dra'i chos mchog gi ye shes chos can/ chos 'dra/ dmigs pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa skye 'gag med pa sogs kyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la gnyis te/ mthong lam dang / bsgom lam mo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ye shes mdor bstan/ rnam pa rgyas par bshad/ gzhan gyi log rtog spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/

dang po ni/ raṃng byams mgon chos can/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam gyi mjug thogs su shes bya byang sems kyi lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dman mchog gi go rim la dgongs nas de ltar 'chad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bdeṃn dang rnamaṃ byang sems kyi shes bzod skad cig bcu drug po chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ 'di phyi'i phan yon khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ bzhiṃn lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ khyod la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod de/ khyod la de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag phan tshun rnam grangs kyis gnas pa khas mi len pa sogs la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i mnyam gzhag skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ dang po sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa ni/ doṃn daṃm byang sems kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag skad cig ma dang po chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sdug bsngal chos bzod yin te/ byang sems kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag gang zhig de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag phan tshun rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas mi len pa la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung bden pa ni/ gzugs de 'dra'i lnga pa chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i kun 'byung chos bzod yin te/ gang zhig gzugs sogs rtag chad med pa la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa 'gog bden gyi rnam pa ni/ gzuṃgs de 'dra'i dgu pa chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i 'gog pa la chos bzod yin te/

gang zhig gzugs sogs rang bzhin kho nas stong pa nyid la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /bzhi pa lam bden gyi rnam pa ni/ ngoṃ boṃ de 'dra'i skad cig bcu gsum pa chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i lam chos bzod yin te/ gang zhig gzugs sogs dang / myang 'das la mngon zhen zhi ba'i nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ sun 'byin bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khaṃ ciṃg rgyan gyi 'grel byed kha cig na re/ skabs 'dir mthong lam rgyas bshad kyi gzhung gis rnam pa ma bshad par mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gi rab dbye tsam bstan pa yin la/ skabs dang por bshad pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun dang / 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i nges 'byed cha mthun ston pa'i gzhung gis kyang rnam pa ma bshad par de dag gi rab dbye tsam bstan pa yin no zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhaṃn daṃg de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag zhes sogs kyi gzhung chos can/ mnyam bzhag du sgom pa'i rim pa dang rjes thob tu yid la bya ba'i rim pa ma bstan par thal/ rnam pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ gzhan yang dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang zhes sogs dang / dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir zhes sogs kyi gzhung drang du mi rung bar thal/ gzhung de dag gis dmigs rnam ma bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgom lam la gnyis te/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam mo/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ mthoṃng baṃ'i skye ba'i rim pa dang bstun na mthongaṃ lam gyi rjes su sgom lam brjod par bya ba yin na yang byams mgon gyis thog mar sgom lam gyi byed pa bstan pa chos can/ rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa yod de/
