gzhung nyung ba'i phyir dang / gdul bya rgyu sgom lam la zhugs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kuṃn naṃs theg chen gyi sgom lam sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i nyon mongs kyi nus pa zhi ba la sogs pa'i yon tan drug po de chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa yin te/ theg chen gyi sgom lam sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnaṃm paṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu bzhi dang ldan te/ nang gi nyer 'tshe zhi ba gsum/ phyi'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba gcig dang ldan pa'i phyir/ yang dag de chos can/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang ldan te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ rtenaṃ gyiṃ de chos can/ bdag po'i 'bras bu dang ldan te/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs mchod pa'i yul du byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbye ba bstan te mtshams sbyar/ so so'i rang bzhin phye ste bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byedaṃ paṃ'i theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ khyod la zag bcas dang zag med sgom lam gnyis yod de/ khyod la gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i sgom lam dang / de med pa'i sgom lam gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ zag bcas sgom lam dang / zag med sgom lam mo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbye ba'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ phye ba so so'i rang bzhin bshad/ byed las kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ'i phyiraṃ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam chos can/ mos bsngo rjes su yi rang bsgom lam gsum yod de/ dge rtsa sog par byed pa dang / mi zad par byed pa dang / spel bar byed pa'i sgom lam gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mos sgom lam/ bsngo sgom lam/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam mo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mos pa'i dbye ba dang / mos pa'i phan yon no/

/dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnamaṃs kyisaṃ byams mgon chos can/ zag bcas sgom lam gsum gyi nang nas dang por mos pa sgom lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ zag bcas sgom lam gsum gyi nang nas thog mar dge rtsa sog pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ moṃs dang jiṃ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kyi yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos pa'i sgom lam de chos can/ mos pa sgom lam yin te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos pa'i mos pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byung gnas su mos pa'i zhes sogs so sor phral nas rang don mos pa sgom lam sogs gsum du phral nas yang 'god do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃm dang deṃ mos pa sgom lam chos can/ nyi shu rtsa bdun yod de/ rang don mos pa sgom lam dgu/ gnyis don mos pa sgom lam dgu/ gzhan don mos pa sgom lam dgu rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ bsgoṃm shes rab pha rol phyin pa la zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du bstod bkur bsngags gsum mdzad tshul bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sheṃs dang jiṃ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rang dang gnyis don mos pa'i gnas skabs dgu la bstod bkur dgu/ gzhan don mos pa'i gnas skabs dgu la bsngags pa dgu mdzad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems spro ba skyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ deṃs naṃ mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems la sangs rgyas kyis bstod bkur bsngags pa mdzad pa chos can/ gcam bu'i ngo bo ma yin te/ yon tan dang 'tshams pa'i bstod sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsngo ba sgom lam la gnyis las/

dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ mos pa sgom lam gyi 'og tu bsngo ba sgom lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mos pas bsags pa'i dge rtsa bsngo bas mi zad par byed dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yoṃngs dang jiṃ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kyi dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sgyur bar byed pa'i sgom lam de chos can/ bsngo ba sgom lam yin te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam chos can/ rnam pa bcu gnyis yod de/ spyi'i rang bzhin/ mngon zhen 'gog pa drug zung 'jug gi rnam pa/ mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba/ rnam pa'i rab dbye gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rjes su yi rang sgom lam la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ bsngo ba sgom lam gyi 'og tu rjes su yi rang sgom lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bsngo bas bsngos pa'i dge rtsa yi rang gis mngon par spel dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ thaṃbs dang raṃb sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kyi rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang ba'i sgom lam de chos can/ rjes su yi rang ba'i sgom lam yin te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig dge rtsa spel bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ deṃ laṃ mos pa sgom lam chos can/ byed las khyad par can dang ldan te/ dge rtsa sog par byed pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam chos can/ chos 'dra/ dge rtsa mi zad par byed pa'i phyir/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam chos can/ chos 'dra/ dge rtsa spel bar byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la gnyis te/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam mo/ /dang po la gnyis las/

dang po ni/ zaṃg paṃ byams mgon chos can/ zag bcas sgom lam gyi 'og tu zag med sgom lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dman mchog gi go rim la dgongs nas de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ zag med sgom lam chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis yod de/ spang bya'i dngos gnyen dang / rnam grol lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ dang gzuṃgs sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi ngo bo yin te/ gzugs sogs kyi gnas tshul mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom pa'i spang ba gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ mchoṃg dang gzhaṃn sgrub pa sgom lam gyis bsdus pa'i sher phyir chos can/ sbyin sogs gzhan las mchog yin te/ sbyin sogs gzhan gyis sangs rgyas thob pa khyod la rag las pa'i phyir/ kuṃn dang choṃs sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ yul la mngon par zhen pa'i tshul gyis 'du mi byed de/ chos thams cad skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nges shes 'dren par byed pa'i phyir/ chosaṃ dang deṃ sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ byed las khyad par can dang ldan te/ rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la chos rnams mi dmigs pa'i rtogs pa skyed pa'i phyir/ doṃn dang doṃn de chos can/ don chen po dang ldan te/ sangs rgyas nyid du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa'i rab dbye dang / 'bras bu rnam dag sgom lam dngos so/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ'i 'oṃg sangs rgyas brten dang sbyin sogs dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i mthun rkyen dang / 'gal rkyen bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ saṃngs rgyasaṃ dang saṃngs rgyasaṃ sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa sogs gsum po chos can/ rang 'bras rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i rgyu yin te de skye ba la phan 'dogs byed yin pa'i phyir/

bduṃd dang baṃdud bdud kyis gnod pa byas pa sogs bzhi po chos can/ rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i 'gal rkyen yin te/ de skye ba la bar du gcod byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag du bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'braṃs dang 'phaṃgs sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam chos can/ khyod rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs kyang des rnam par dag pa yin te/ khyod des dag pa'i dag pa dang / khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs des dag pa'i dag pa gnyis rang spyi gnyis char du tha dad med par don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'phags bzhi'i rnam dag spyir bstan/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar sgrub/ sgrub byed la klan ka spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyonaṃ dang 'doṃd nyan thos kyi mthong lam rnam grol lam de chos can/ nyan thos kyi rnam dag yin te/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ sheṃs dang deṃ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi mthong lam rnam grol lam chos can/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag yin te/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib dang / shes sgrib gzung rtog tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam grol yin pa'i phyir/ laṃm dang theṃg sa dang po'i rnam grol lam chos can/ byang sems kyi rnam dag yin te/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi sgrib pa gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni ma mtha' ngos bzung ba'o/ /saṃngs dang nyonaṃ sangs rgyas sa'i rnam grol lam chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag yin te/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ laṃm sheṃs sa dgu la ni chen po yi zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rnam dag shin tu ba dang shin tu ba ma yin pa'i khyad par bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ saṃ dang 'doṃd sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag chos can/ rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ rang rgyu rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam des khams gsum gyi shes sgrib mtha' dag gi gnyen po byas pa las byung ba'i rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos sogs kyi rnam dag gsum po chos can/ rnam dag shin tu ba ma yin te/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam des khams gsum gyi shes sgrib mtha' dag gi gnyen po ma byas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ laṃ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ khams gsum gyi shes sgrib mtha' dag gi gnyen por grub ste/ khams gsum gyi gzung 'dzin mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ bsal bya klan ka sel byed gnyen po/ klan ka bsal bas grub pa'i don no/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ gnyen po chung rim nas skye shing spang bya che rim nas 'gags pa mi 'thad de/ go rim de las bzlog pa 'thad pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ gos la gnyen po chung rim nas skye shing / spang bya che rim nas 'gags pa'i dpe yod de/ gos la chags pa'i dri ma rags pa 'bad pa chung ngus sel zhing / phra mo 'bad pa chen pos sel dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sgoṃm laṃm paṃ'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar grub ste/ theg chen gyi sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs dgu po de khams gsum sa dgu'i sgom spangs chen po'i chen po sogs dgu'i gnyen por grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni shes rab sogs so// //gsum pa rnam par dag byed gzhi shes la gsum ste/

'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi thamaṃs caṃd byams mgon chos can/ lam shes kyi 'og tu gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyis lam legs par shes pa mtshan 'dzin mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang / mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyen po yin pa'i khyad par shes pa la rag las pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lam shes rnam par dag par byed pa'i gzhi shes/ skabs don theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i gzhi shes rnam pa dang sbyar ba'i ched du mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi shes kyi ngo bo/ nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rtsa ba dang / 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshu rol byang sems kyi mthong sgom bar chad med lam chos can/ skabs gsum pa 'dir gzhi shes kyis bsdus pa'i sher phyin du 'dod de/ khams gsum gyi gzung 'dzin mnyam nyid du rtogs par ma zad par 'khor 'das bar gsum la mi gnas shing dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi gzhi shes/ shugs bstan nyan rang gi gzhi shes so/ /dang po ni/ duṃs gsuṃm byang sems kyi gzhi shes chos can/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ shes rab kyis srid mtha' dang / snying rjes zhi mtha' gnon dus kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kuṃn sheṃs theg dman gyi gzhi shes chos can/ srid zhi la gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ thabs shes khyad par can dang bral ba'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/

dang po ni/ luṃgs laṃs nyan rang gi gzhi shes sher phyin la ring ba dang / byang sems kyi gzhi shes sher phyin la nye ba'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ de gnyis kas dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis kas gzhi rten 'brel gyi don rtogs pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ niṃ byang sems kyi gzhi shes chos can/ rjes thob tu mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod na/ rnam mkhyen la ring bar 'gyur te/ rjes thob du mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod na rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i phyir/ deṃ niṃ de chos can/ rjes thob du mtshan mar mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod na rnam mkhyen la nye bar 'gyur te/ de ltar spyod na rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i phyir/ nye ring gi yul skabs dang po'i rnam mkhyen dang / nye ring du 'gro ba po sngar bshad pa'i gzhi shes kyi ngo bo yin par de ni zhes pa'i tshig gong 'og gnyis kyis gsal lo/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes 'bras yum la ring ba'i rgyu mtshan/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes 'bras yum la nye ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ sgyuṃ maṃ theg dman gyi gzhi shes chos can/ 'bras yum la ring ba yin te/ dus gsum mnyam nyid du mi shes pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byaṃng chubaṃ byang sems kyi gzhi shes chos can/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes yin te/ dus gsum mnyam nyid du shes pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ mtshan 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ thabaṃs maṃ nyan thos kyi gzhi shes dang / byang sems kyi gzhi shes gnyis chos can/ 'bras yum la nye ring gi khyad par yod de/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas mi mkhas kyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i khyad par la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ spang bya dang / gnyen po'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang zhes sogs gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes de mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes su bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugaṃs dang gzugaṃs gzhi'i chos nyid dang chos can la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin chos can/ byang sems lam gyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ byang sems lam gyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ sbyiṃn dang zaṃg lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byaṃng chuṃb sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med zhes so gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes de gnyen po gzhi shes su bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sbyinaṃ dang 'khoṃr sa bdun pa man chad kyi sbyin sogs la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i mkhyen pa de chos can/ lam la mtshan 'dzin 'gog byed yin te/ sbyin sogs 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa la rang gnas nas gzhan sbyor bar byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ spong byed gnyen po/ yul zab par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mi mthun phyogs su bstan pa/ mi mthun phyogs su bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyaṃl dang deṃ de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs gnas su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ byang sems lam gyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ byang sems lam gyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yaṃng jiṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ choṃs dang gaṃng de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs gnas su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/

mi mthun phyogs yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa zab mo spros bral yin pa la mtshan mar bzung ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'oṃ naṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ choṃs dang gzuṃgs ma dag sa bdun gyi bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi ngos skal gyi mtshan 'dzin spong byed yin te/ gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sa bdun pa man chad kyi bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yul zab par bstan pa la gnyis te/ rtogs dka' bar bshad pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yangaṃ jiṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mthoṃng dang gaṃng de bzhin gshegs pa chos can/ don dam par zab mo yin te/ don dam par rtogs par dka' ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yangaṃ deṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzuṃgs dang gaṃng de chos can/ don dam par rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ don dam par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa don bsdu ba la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaṃr gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin mi mthun phyogs dang / mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyen po yin pa'i khyad par de chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya ba yin te/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir rtogs par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ thamaṃs caṃd nyan rang gi gzhi shes mi mthun phyogs dang / byang sems kyi gzhi shes gnyen po yin pa'i khyad par chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ gnyis pa skabs don theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i gzhi shes la gsum ste/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam/ sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sbyor ba'i dbye ba dang / sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid do/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni deṃ ltaraṃ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang zhes sogs gsungs pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen por gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba sgom tshul bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugaṃs soṃgs gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba chos can/ rnam pa bcu yod de/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba bzhi/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzuṃgs laṃs byang sems kyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag chos can/ gzhi'i ngo bo la zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ gzhi'i ngo bo la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du de chos can/ gzhi'i khyad par dang / mtshan nyid gsum dang / chags pa med pa dang / gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang / byed pa po med pa dang / bya dka' rnam gsum dang / 'bras bu mi gtong ba dang / srung byed gzhan la rag ma las pa dang / snang ba rnam bdun la zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ de dag la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shugaṃs kyiṃs theg dman gyi sbyor lam mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ zhen spyod dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ gzhi'i ngo bo dang khyad par sogs la mngon par zhen pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mnyaṃm paṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzuṃgs dang gzuṃgs byang sems kyi sbyor lam mnyam gzhag chos can/ sbyor ba'i mnyam pa nyid yin te/ gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo dang / khyad par dang / dbye ba dang / yul can rnams rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyoraṃ baṃ'i byams mgon chos can/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mnyam pa nyid kyi 'og tu mthong lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

sbyor lam gyi skabs kyi sbyor ba'i mnyam pa nyid las mthong lam 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sduṃg dang bdeṃn byang sems kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug po chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ rtag mi rtag sogs kyi spros pa so gnyis dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdenaṃ paṃ'i sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzuṃgs rtagaṃs sogs so/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi mthong lam/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam mo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ dang po sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa ni/ ngoṃ boṃ byang sems kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag skad cig ma dang po chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sdug bsngal chos bzod yin te/ gzugs sogs rtag mi rtag gi spros bral la gtso bor nges pa 'dren nus kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa ni/ rgyuṃ dngaṃ de 'dra'i skad cig lnga pa chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i kun 'byung chos bzod yin te/ kun 'byung rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa'i spros bral la gtso bor nges pa 'dren nus kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa 'gog bden gyi rnam pa ni/ gaṃng giṃ de 'dra'i skad cig dgu pa chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i 'gog pa chos bzod yin te/ 'gog bden 'gog pa yin ma yin gyi spros bral la gtso bor nges pa 'dren nus kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /bzhi pa lam bden gyi rnam pa ni/ laṃm daṃng de 'dra'i skad cig bcu gsum pa chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i lam chos bzod yin te/

lam bden lam yin ma yin gyi spros bral la gtso bor nges pa 'dren nus kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gsum la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ mdor bstan gyi ngag don 'god/ gnyis pa ni/ nyanaṃ thosaṃ nyan thos kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug po chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas shugs la bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ rtag sogs bcu drug gi spros bral mngon sum du rtogs shing mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi spros bral ma rtogs pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyanaṃ thosaṃ byams mgon chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir mthong lam gyi rjes su sgom lam ma bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs de byang chub sems dpas gzhan don du mngon sum du mthong bar bya ba yin gyi mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom par bya ba min pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rnam pa dang sbyor ba'i ched du mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang zhes sogs gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mkhyen gsum rgyas par bstan pa'i mjug bsdu bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ rab 'byor yum 'di ni chos gang ston par byed pa'am zhes pa nas gzugs med pa'i khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig chos can/ gzhi shes dang por byas pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum rdzogs par bstan pa yin te/ le'u gsum gyi brjod bya mkhyen pa gsum po de rnam par bsdu ba'i ched du gzhi shes dang por byas pa'i sgo nas bsdus te bstan pa'i mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bshadaṃ maṃ rab 'byor yum 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ster bar byed pa ma yin 'phrogs par byed pa ma yin zhes sogs kyi mdo tshig gsum pa chos can/

mkhyen gsum rdzogs par bstan pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum rgyas par bshad zin pa'i mjug tu bsdus te bstan pa'i mdo tshig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni sheṃs raṃb sogs so// //gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba la bzhi ste/ dbang thob pa'i don du bsgom pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ brtan pa thob pa'i don du bsgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ brtan pa thob nas cig char du bsgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'brel dgod pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thamaṃs caṃd byams mgon chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi 'og tu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la bab pa'i don rnam par bsdus nas sbyor bas sgom dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sbyor ba la 'jug tshul gtan la dbab pa/ sbyor ba skyes pa'i go rim mo/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ sbyor ba po'i gang zag yul can sbyor ba'i dbye ba/ sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhiṃ dang rtagaṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi bden bzhi'i steng gi rtag par med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum chos can/ khyod las bsgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ khyod theg chen gyi sbyor bas mtshon zhing mngon du byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum gyi mtshan mtshon ni ma yin no/ /kuṃn dang deṃ 'dir bstan rnam pa chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa/ lam shes kyi rnam pa/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'o/

/dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ medaṃ paṃ'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa chos can/ nyer bdun yod de/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i rnam pa bcu drug rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i rnam pa bcu gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa so sor bshad/ grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa/ lam bden gyi rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa bzhi po chos can/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mi rtag sogs bzhi la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ gnaṃs meṃd don dam par sdug bsngal skye ba'i gnas med par rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa bzhi po chos can/ chos 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rgyu sogs bzhi la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba don dam par dman pa nas mchog tu 'gro ba med par rtogs pa sogs rnam pa bzhi po chos can/ chos 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi 'gog pa sogs bzhi la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rten lam gyi dbye ba/ lam so so'i rnam pa/ grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nyonaṃ moṃngs byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyis bsdus pa'i lam bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ gsum yod de/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med kyi rtogs rig gcig shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag bcas dang / zag med kyi rtogs rigs gnyis rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lam dang po'i rnam pa/ gnyis pa'i rnam pa/ gsum pa'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ don dam par byed pa po'i bdag med rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa bzhi po chos can/

gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin te/ lam bden gyi lam sogs bzhi la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyiṃs paṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag bcas kyi rtogs rigs yin te/ phyi gzung ba'i yul la bden 'dzin spong byed kyi gnyen po'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gsuṃm paṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba sogs drug po rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa de chos can/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med kyi rtogs rigs yin te/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung bar rnam par rtogs pa sogs drug gi gnyen po'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ ltaṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyiṃr bstaṃn sogs so/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa la gsum ste/ dbye ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de'iṃ 'oṃg sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni rgyuṃ dang kuṃn lam shes kyi rnam pa chos can/ sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa brgyad/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bdun/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa lnga/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ kun 'byung bden pa spang gnyen gyi sgo nas bshad/ lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas bshad/ sdug bden rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad/ 'gog bden dri bral gyi sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ dang goṃ lam shes kyis 'dod chags dang bral bar rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa gsum po chos can/

rgyu'i rnam pa yin te/ rgyu'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la 'dun pa sogs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ 'doṃd dang kuṃn lam shes kyis don dam par 'dod chags med par rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa gsum po chos can/ kun 'byung gi rnam pa yin te/ kun 'byung gi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sgo nas dug gsum gyi gnyen por gyur pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ nyoṃn dang rabaṃ lam shes kyis don dam par nyon mongs med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ rab tu skye ba'i rnam pa yin te/ rab skye'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sgo nas kun rtog gi gnyen po gyur pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ semaṃs dang rkyenaṃ laṃm shes kyis sems can med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ rkyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ rkyen gyi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sgo nas sems can du mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni deṃ rnamaṃs sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshadaṃ medaṃ lam shes kyis chos nyid tshad med par rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa bdun po de chos can/ lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ lam bden gyi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sogs 'gre/ deṃ rnamaṃ lam bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ bdun yod de/ lam gyi rnam pa gnyis/ rigs pa'i rnam pa gnyis/ sgrub pa'i rnam pa gnyis/ nges 'byin gyi rnam pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ miṃ rtagaṃ lam shes kyis sdug bsngal gyi bden pa mi rtag par rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa lnga po chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sogs 'gre/ deṃ ltaraṃ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa chos can/ lnga yod de/ rang mtshan gyi rnam pa bzhi/ spyi mtshan gyi rnam pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/

so sor bshad pa dang / grangs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dngos po'i grangs nges dgag pa/ mngon zhen gyi dri ma dgag pa/ byed pa po'i rtogs pas dben pa/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma sel ba'i nges 'byung ngo / /dang po ni/ 'goṃg paṃ'i lam shes kyis dag pa gnyis ldan gyi nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa gsum rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ 'gog bden gyi 'gog pa'i rnam pa yin te/ 'gog pa'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sogs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhiṃ baṃ'i lam shes kyis dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la sogs pa brgyad rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ zhi ba'i rnam pa yin te/ zhi ba'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sogs 'gre/ gsum pa ni/ gyaṃ nomaṃ lam shes kyis dag pa gnyis ldan gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ gya nom pa'i rnam pa yin te/ gya nom gyi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sogs 'gre/ bzhi pa ni/ ngesaṃ paṃr lam shes kyis dag pa gnyis ldan chos thams cad stong pa nyid la sogs pa bzhi rtogs pa'i rnam pa chos can/ nges 'byung gi rnam pa yin te/ nges 'byung gi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i sogs 'gre/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ bcu drug yod de/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa gsum/ zhi ba'i rnam pa brgyad/ gya nom gyi rnam pa gcig nges 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grangs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ spyiraṃ bstaṃn sogs so/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de'i 'oṃg sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dranaṃ dang dranaṃ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ brgya dang bcu yod de/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sum cu so bdun/ byang sems dang thun mong ba'i lam shes kyi rnam pa sum cu so bzhi/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa sum cu rtsa dgu rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la gsum ste/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa/ byang sems dang thun mong ba'i lam shes kyi rnam pa/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / grangs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la sde tshan bdun las/ dang po dngos po la yongs su rtogs pa'i lam ni/ deṃ laṃ mthun yul gyi ngos nas 'god na tshogs lam chung ngu'i gnas skabs kyi dran pa nyer bzhag gi rnam pa bzhi po chos can/ dngos po la yongs su rtogs pa'i lam yin te/ dmigs pa lus sogs la dmigs nas rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis brtags te gcod par byed pa'i tshogs lam chung ngu ba'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos kyi ngos nas 'god na sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dran pa nyer gzhag gi rnam pa chos can/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig dran pa nye bzhag gi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam ni/ de'iṃ 'ogaṃ tshogs lam 'bring po ba'i rgyud kyi yang dag spong ba'i rnam pa bzhi po chos can/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam yin te/ dge sdig gi blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa'i tshogs lam 'bring pos bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam ni/ brtsoṃn 'gruṃs tshogs lam chen po'i rgyud kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i rnam pa bzhi po chos can/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam yin te/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsten pa las byung zhing sems gnas pa las rung du byed pa'i tshogs lam chen pos bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ bzhi pa mngon par rtogs par sbyor ba'i lam ni/ semaṃs yongaṃs drod kyi gnas skabs kyi dbang po'i rnam pa lnga po chos can/

mngon par rtogs par sbyor ba'i lam yin te/ drod rtse gang rung gis bsdus pa'i rnam byang gi dbang po yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ lnga pa mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel pa'i lam ni/ droṃ baṃ sbyor lam bzod pa'i gnas skabs kyi stobs kyi rnam pa lnga po chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lam yin te/ bzod mchog gang rung gis bsdus pa'i rnam byang gi stobs yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ drug pa mngon par rtogs pa'i lam ni/ droṃ baṃ mthong lam gyi gnas skabs kyi byang chub kyi yan lag gi rnam pa bdun po chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam yin te/ bden pa gsar du mngon sum du mthong ba'i mnyam gzhag gis bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ bdun pa rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam ni/ bdeṃn paṃ sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag gi rnam pa chos can/ rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam yin te/ sgom spang gi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i sgom lam gyis bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaṃr sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ khyod la sum cu rtsa bdun yod de/ khyod kyi mthun yul sum cu rtsa bdun yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la sum cu rtsa bdun du phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa byang sems dang thun mong ba'i lam shes kyi rnam pa la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / grangs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la sde tshan drug las/ dang po gnyen po'i lam ni/ lamaṃ shesaṃ mthun yul gyi sgo nas 'god na byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam thar sgo gsum chos can/ gnyen po'i lam yin te/ bdag tu lta ba sogs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos kyi sgo nas 'god na sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam thar sgo gsum chos can/

byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ ltaraṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam par thar ba'i sgo chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin sogs gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sprul pa'i lam ni/ sprulaṃ paṃ'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs can gyi rnam par thar pa dang po gnyis chos can/ sprul pa'i lam yin te/ gzhan don du sprul pa sna tshogs sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gzugaṃs sdugaṃ paṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sdug pa'i rnam thar chos can/ sprul pa'i lam yin te/ gzugs sdug pa dang mi sdug pa sprul pa la dga' mi dga'i rnam rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis ka la mthun chos 'gre/ deṃ ltaraṃ gzugs can gyi rnam thar chos can/ gsum yod de/ sprul pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po gnyis/ dga' mi dga'i rnam rtog gi gnyen po gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam ni/ mthongaṃ baṃ'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi po chos can/ thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin yin te/ gzugs med zhi ba'i ro myong gi sgrib pa las grol ba'i gzugs med kyi rnam thar yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog pa'i rnam thar chos can/ zhi bar gnas pa'i lam yin te/ tshor 'du rags pa zhi ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi rnam thar yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ deṃ ltaṃr mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam chos can/ rnam pa lnga yod de/ thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin bzhi/ zhi bar gnas pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam ni 'jiṃg rtenaṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug chos can/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yin te/ 'phags rgyud kyi zag med kyi snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ lnga pa spong ba'i lam ni/ spongaṃ baṃ'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi bden bzhi'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ spong ba'i lam yin te/ bar chad med pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ drug pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ni/ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi phar phyin bcu chos can/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam yin te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub du bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul yin pa'i phyir/ mthun chos 'gre/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ sum cu rtsa bzhi yod de/ khyod kyi mthun chos de la sum cu rtsa bzhi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la sum cu rtsa bzhir phye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ stobs bcu nas sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar sum cu rtsa dgu chos can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ 'phags pa 'og ma las rtogs rigs phul du byung ba'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ brten pa yon tan bshad pa/ rten ye shes bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ stobs kyi rnam pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa so so yang dag rig pa'i rnam pa/ ma 'dres pa'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ stobs kyi rnam pa yin te/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa sogs shes bya mtha' yas pa la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ ngaṃ niṃ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa yin te/ rang don phun tshogs brnyes pa dang / gzhan don phun tshogs sgrub pa'i thabs dam bcas pa la chos mthun pa'i rgol ba med cing / chos mi mthun gyi rgol bas mi brdzi ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnamaṃ grangaṃs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i rnam pa yin te/ bshad bya 'chad byed gnyis la thogs med du 'jug pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ so sor bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ dang po spyod pa ma 'dres pa ni/ 'khruṃl paṃ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ spyod pa ma 'dres pa yin te/ sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa la nyes pa mi mnga' ba'i mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtogs pa ma 'dres pa ni/ 'duṃn paṃ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ rtogs pa ma 'dres pa yin te/ 'dun pa sogs nyams pa mi mnga' ba'i mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phrin las ma 'dres pa ni/ skuṃ daṃng sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ phrin las ma 'dres pa yin te/ sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis zin pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ye shes ma 'dres pa ni/ 'dasaṃ paṃ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ ye shes ma 'dres pa yin te/ dus gsum la chags thogs med pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa chos can/ bco brgyad yod de/ spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rten ye shes bshad pa ni/ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ ci lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/

chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ rang byung gi rnam pa yin te/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad la mnga' bsgyur ba'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ sum cu rtsa dgu yod de/ stobs bcu nas sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ ngo bo'i sgo nas so so'i don bsdu ba/ grangs kyi sgo nas thun mong gi don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa chos can/ zag pa med pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang don du mnyam gzhag du sgom par bya ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa chos can/ zag bcas zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhan don du rjes thob tu shes par bya ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ lamaṃ shesaṃ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi lam shes kyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug chos can/ zag bcas zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyon sgrib ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ rnamaṃ paṃ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu po chos can/ zag pa med pa yin te/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zad par spangs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ skabs 'dir bstan gyi rnam pa chos can/ brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gsum yod de/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun/ lam shes kyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa sbyor ba po'i gang zag la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyoraṃ baṃ byams mgon chos can/ rnam pa'i 'og tu sbyor ba po'i gang zag 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor bas rnam pa sgom pa la sbyor ba de yang sbyor ba po'i gang zag bstan pa sngon du song na go sla ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sangaṃs dang 'daṃs byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ yum nyan pa'i snod yin te/ yum nyan pa'i phyi nang gi mthun rkyen khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ sangaṃs dang deṃ de chos can/ yum gyi tshig blo la 'dzin pa dang / don mi brjed par sems pa dang / bsam byung gi rigs pas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod yin te/ de ltar byed pa'i phyi nang gi mthun rkyen khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yul can sbyor ba'i dbye ba la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzuṃgs laṃ theg chen gyi sbyor ba chos can/ rnam pa nyi shu yod de/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ gzuṃgs laṃ byang sems kyi tshogs lam khyad par can gyi mngon par rtogs pa chos can/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ gzugs sogs don dam par gnas bya ma yin par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan bzhi la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shesaṃ rabaṃ de chos can/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa ma thob pas sher phyin la skrag pa skye srid pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba chos can/ khyod la mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du yod de/ khyod kyi sgom bya rnam pa de la mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa gsum du yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du yod pa'i phyir/

des lhag ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o/ /bzhi pa sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos la gsum ste/ thob par bya ba yon tan/ dor bar bya ba skyon/ shes par bya ba mtshan nyid do/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yonaṃ tanaṃ byams mgon chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i 'og tu de'i yon tan 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa la de'i yon tan mthong ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bduṃd dang bduṃd theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i bdud kyi mthu bcom pa la sogs pa bcu bzhi chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan yin te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa'i gnas skabs kyi phan yon yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de'iṃ 'ogaṃ byams mgon chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi 'og tu theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ yon tan mthong nas theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa la bar chad byed pa'i skyon shes pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skyonaṃ dang tshegaṃs theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa'i gnas skabs su tshegs chen pos 'thob pa sogs bzhi bcu rtsa drug chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon yin te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ grangs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ goṃ rimaṃ byams mgon chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon gyi rjes su theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ yon tan dang skyon la blang dor byed pa'i sgo nas theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa la theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid shes pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbye ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ so so'i rang bzhin phye ste bshad pa'o/

/dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gaṃng giṃs theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid chos can/ rnam pa bzhi yod de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa gsum/ las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byedaṃ paṃr theg chen sbyor ba'i shes khyad byed gsum chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug po theg chen gyi sbyor bar mtshon par byed pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ lasaṃ su ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug po chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan/ ngo bo nyid mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dbye ba'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ shes mtshan chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba'i rnam pa gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ reṃ zhigaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ dang deṃ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcu drug yod de/ khyod kyi yul de la bcu drug yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la bcu drug tu phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ thamaṃs dang 'diṃ gzhi shes sbyor bas yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar shes pa sogs kyi shes pa bcu drug chos can/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin te/ nyon mongs kyis dben pa sogs kyi ngo bo nyid bzhi po theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor bar mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas shes pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/

dang po ni/ de'iṃ 'ogaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ stongaṃ dang stongaṃ lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcu drug yod de/ khyod kyi yul de la bcu drug yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la bcu drug tu phye ba'i phyir/ lamaṃ dang 'diṃ lam shes sbyor bas stong pa nyid rtogs pa sogs kyi shes pa bcu drug po chos can/ lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin te/ bya dka' ba sogs kyi ngo bo nyid lnga po lam shes sbyor bar mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas shes pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ'i 'ogaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ dang deṃ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcu drug yod de/ khyod kyi yul de la bcu drug yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la bcu drug tu phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ rnamaṃ dang 'diṃ rnam mkhyen sbyor bas mthong chos la bder gnas rtogs pa sogs kyi shes pa bcu drug chos can/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin te/ dmigs pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bdun po rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas shes pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khyad mtshan la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos so/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr byams mgon chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan gyi 'og tu de'i khyad mtshan 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ shes mtshan gyi skabs su sbyor ba gsum gyi shes mtshan gsum du phye ba'i khyad par shes par bya dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ rtsa ba ni/ bsaṃm miṃ theg chen sbyor bas chos nyid rtog ge'i blos bsam gyis mi khyab par rtogs pa sogs kyi rnam pa bcu drug po chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin te/ ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug po theg chen gyi sbyor bar mtshon par byed pa gsum gyi nang nas byed pa'i khyad par gyi cha yin pa'i phyir/

'grel pa ni bsaṃm gyiṃs chos 'dra/ ngo bo nyid mtshan phyi ma bcu gnyis lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor bar mtshon par byed pa'i khyad par gyi cha yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ yangaṃ bsaṃm sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gang khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos/ gang las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bsaṃm miṃ theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan chos can/ rnam pa bcu drug yod de/ yul bden bzhi'i steng gi khyad chos bcu drug rtogs pa'i skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃng giṃs theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan bcu drug po chos can/ khyod la khyad mtshan zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyis rang gang la ldan pa'i sbyor ba de theg dman gyi sbyor ba las rtogs rigs kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par mtshon nus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid dngos dang / dman lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ khyad par gyi dbye ba dang / khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ yangaṃ dgaṃ sogs dang / gnyis pa ni/ gangaṃ giṃs sogs te/ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de'iṃ phyiraṃ byams mgon chos can/ khyad mtshan 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir gang las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam dngos su mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ skabs 'dir de shugs kyis go ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byed mtshan la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khyadaṃ paraṃ/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang zhes sogs bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis byed mtshan bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyad mtshan dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba'i byed pa bde blag tu rtog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba dang / mtshon pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ phanaṃ dang maṃ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor bas ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa sgrub pa sogs kyi byed pa gsum po chos can/

theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed mtshan yin te/ nyon mongs kyis dben pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bzhi po theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor bar mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ miṃ dang gtanaṃ lamaṃ shes sbyor bas gtan du phan pa sgrub pa sogs kyi byed pa bdun po chos can/ lam shes sbyor ba'i byed mtshan yin te/ bya dka' ba la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bdun po lam shes sbyor bar mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ thaṃ dang rnamaṃ rnam mkhyen sbyor bas chos thams cad ston pa nye bar sgrub pa'i byed pa chos can/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan yin te/ dmigs pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid lnga po rnam mkhyen sbyor bar mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃ dang deṃ phan pa la sogs pa'i byed pa bcu gcig chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan yin te/ ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug po theg chen gyi sbyor bar mtshon pa'i byed pa gsum gyi nang nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byedaṃ paṃ'i nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis ngo bo nyid mtshan bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byed mtshan dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba dang / mtshon pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ nyonaṃ dang 'doṃd nyon mongs kyis dben pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bzhi po chos can/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan yin te/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba gang la mtshon par bya ba'i mtshan gzhi'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dkaṃ' dang donaṃ bya dka' ba la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid lnga po chos can/

lam shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan yin te/ rtags 'gre/ dmigaṃs dang thamaṃs dmigs pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bdun po chos can/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan yin te/ rtags 'gre/ gnyis pa ni/ ngoṃ dang deṃ nyon mongs kyis dben pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bcu drug po chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan yin te/ rtags 'gre/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid chos can/ phye na dgu bcu rtsa gcig yod de/ shes mtshan bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ khyad mtshan bcu drug byed mtshan bcu gcig ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi go rim la gsum ste/ thogs pa med pa'i sgrub pas bsdus pa'i sbyor ba/ 'dzin pa med pa'i sbyor bas bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thaṃr paṃ'i byams mgon chos can/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu thar pa cha mthun 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dge rtsa dang ldan pa la sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid shes pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'gyur bzlog na bde'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshaṃn dang mtshanaṃ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can gyi dad sogs lnga po chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor bas bsdus pa'i thar pa cha mthun yin te/ mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i theg chen las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mkhaṃs paṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos bstan theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi thar pa cha mthun no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / dbang po'i sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sangaṃs dang daṃd theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can de chos can/

khyod la dad sogs lnga yod de/ khyod kyi mkhas bya'i yul de la sangs rgyas sogs lnga yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la dad sogs lngar phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rdzogaṃs dang deṃ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can gyi dad sogs lnga po chos can/ khyod la rno rtul gnyis yod de/ khyod la theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par sla ba dang dka' ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shugaṃs kyisaṃ rang rgyal gyi rigs can tshogs lam pa'i dad sogs lnga po chos can/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub thob par 'gyur te/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i rang rgyal gyi slob lam yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam khyad par can gyi dad sogs lnga po chos can/ nyan thos kyi byang chub thob par 'gyur te/ rtags 'gre/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ tharaṃ pa'iṃ byams mgon chos can/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi 'og tu theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ droṃ baṃ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa sems mnyam pa la sogs pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor bar bstan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin te/ sems can la dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor khyad par can dang ldan pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos kyi don dang / zhar las byung ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ drod kyi dmigs rnam ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa sems mnyam pa sogs bcu dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i drod yin te/

sems can la dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor khyad par can dang ldan pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i drod kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rtse mo'i dmigs rnam ni/ mdoraṃ naṃ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa dge sdig gi blang dor la gzhan 'god pa sogs kyi nges 'byed cha mthun chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i rtse mo yin te/ rtags 'gre/ bzod pa'i dmigs rnam ni/ rtseṃ moraṃ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa bden bzhi shes pa la rang gnas nas gzhan 'god pa sogs kyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i bzod pa yin te/ rtags 'gre/ chos mchog gi dmigs rnam ni/ sngaṃ maṃ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa rang smin grol la gnas nas gzhan 'god pa sogs kyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i chos mchog yin te/ sems can la dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor khyad par can dang ldan pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i chos mchog gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi skabs su lam gsum bstan pa'i 'dod tshul/ sbyor ba gsum gyi skabs su lam gsum bstan pa'i 'dod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ byams mgon chos can/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi skabs su sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan gsum du bstan pa la/ zlos pa'i skyon med de/ rnam pa dang / lam dang / gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i ldog pa nas mkhyen pa gsum gyi skabs su sbyor mthong sgom gsum bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ byams mgon chos can/ sbyor ba dang po gsum gyi skabs su sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan gsum du bstan pa la zlos pa'i skyon med de/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i skabs su sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum dang /

rtse sbyor gyi skabs su sa dgu pa'i ye shes chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum dang / mthar gyis pa'i skabs su sa bcu pa'i ye shes chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum la sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag la gsum ste/ rten gyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ rtags kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ ngo bo'i sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyiraṃ miṃ byams mgon chos can/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi 'og tu phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun thob nas gang zag de phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di'i rigs pa snga ma'i mtshams sbyar la yang thob bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngesaṃ dang saṃ sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun yin te/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i thabs shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ rnamasaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugasaṃ dang gzugasaṃ byang sems sbyor lam pa chos can/ khyod gnas skabs bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin te/ de'i rtags nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yangaṃ ldogaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtags kyi dbye ba dang / rten la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzugasaṃ dang ngoṃ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon gyur ba ldog pa'i lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i drod la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chos can/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mnyam gzhag sngon du song ba yin te/

des drangs pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes 'bras rtags 'god/ de grub nas/ de chos can/ theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byung du rung ste/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mnyam gzhag dang snying rje chen po tshang ba'i phyir zhes rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs 'god/ de grub nas de chos can/ gnas skabs bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog ste/ theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byung du rung ba'i phyir/ zhes ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'god de/ gsum rgyud 'di ni 'grel pa che chung gnyis kyi dgongs pa yin zhing / des lhag ma bcu la yang 'gre'o/ /lusaṃ dang dgeṃ lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri mi 'byung ba'i lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can du bzung nas gsum rgyud 'god/ des lhag ma lnga la 'gre'o/ /gzhanaṃ dang rtogasaṃ bdud kyis lam gzhan du dkrir mi btub pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i bzod pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can du bzung nas gsum rgyud 'god/ des 'og ma la 'gre'o/ /sangasaṃ dang 'khoraṃ spyod pa thams cad la sangs rgyas dges pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i chos mchog la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can du bzung nas gsum rgyud du 'god/ gnyis pa ni/ dadaṃ byang sems sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs chos can/ rnam pa nyi shu yod de/ drod kyi rtags bcu gcig rtse mo'i rtags drug bzod pa'i rtags gnyis/ chos mchog gi rtags gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ngesaṃ paraṃ byams mgon chos can/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

de las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthongaṃ dang sdugaṃ byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ khyod gnas skabs su bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs yod de/ de'i gtan tshigs byang sems kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ skadaṃ cigaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugasaṃ sogs byang sems kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gis drangs pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can bcu drug chos can/ byang sems mthong lam pa gzhan ngor gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yin te/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam gyis drangs pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ rtags kyi dbye ba dang / rtags su 'gyur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la bzhi las sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa ni/ rangaṃ giṃ gzugs sogs la mngon zhen bzlog pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag sngon du song ba yin te/ des drangs pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes 'bras rtags bkod nas rang bzhin dang ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs snga ma las rigs bsgres te des lhag ma gsum la yang 'gre'o/ /kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa ni/ miṃ dgeṃ lus sems yang pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can du bzung nas gsum rgyud 'god/ des lhag ma gsum la 'gre'o/ /'gog bden gyi rnam pa ni/ stongaṃ paṃ phung khams skye mched la gnas pa bkag pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can du bzung nas gsum rgyud 'god/

des lhag ma gsum la 'gre'o/ /lam bden gyi rnam pa ni/ sbyinaṃ paṃ ser sna sogs la gnas pa bkag pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can du bzung nas gsum rgyud 'god/ des lhag ma gsum la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ gzugs sogs la mngon zhen bzlog pa la sogs pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can bcu drug chos can/ khyod la byang sems kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ rnalaṃ 'byoraṃ de la de'i ming gis btags pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ chos nyid mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa rnams sems can 'dul ba'i dgos pa'i dbang ma gtogs par mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa dang mthun par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ ltaraṃ byang sems kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug chos can/ khyod byang sems mthong lam pa rang las rtogs pa dma' ba'i gang zag gi ngor thog mar phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag ma yin par thal/ khyod byang sems mthong lam pa las rtogs pa dma' ba'i gang zag gis thog mar mi rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de'iṃ 'ogaṃ byams mgon chos can/ byang sems mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu/ byang sems kyi sgom lam gyi khyad par 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyad par bzung nas khyad par can gyi blo skyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgomaṃ dang stongaṃ byang sems kyi sgom lam chos can/ theg dman gyi sgom lam las rtogs rigs kyi sgo nas zab ste/ sgro skur dang bral ba'i zab mo stong nyid la sems 'jal rtogs gsum byed pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/

dbu ma pa chos can/ sgom lam gyi ngo bo'i 'dod tshul dngos smra ba'i 'dod tshul las zab ste/ sgom lam don dam par zab mo stong nyid kyi ngo bor 'dod pa'i phyir/ byang sems sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa chos can/ zab mo yin te/ sgro skur dang bral ba'i zab mo stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag gis drangs pa'i gtan tshigs khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rtogs rigs zab pa rgyas par bshad/ ngo bo zab pa rgyas par bshad/ gtan tshigs zab pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sgom lam gyi ngo bo dang / sgom lam gyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi khyad par bstan nas khyad gzhi theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi khyad par 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyad par bzung nas khyad par can gyi blo skye ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngesaṃ shesaṃ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag gis drangs pa'i rjes thob kyi nges shes khyad par can de chos can/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi sgom lam yin te/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs su mthong zin pa'i sgro skur dang bral ba'i zab mo stong nyid kyi don la sems 'jal rtog gsum byed pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ thosaṃ paṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi sgom lam yin te/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs su mthong ba'i zab mo stong nyid kyi don la thos bsam sgom gsum mam/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi shes rab kyis sems 'jal rtog gsum byed pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ rnamasaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ niṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam mnyam gzhag gis drangs pa'i nges shes de la dgur grangs nges te/ theg chen gyi sgom lam mnyam gzhag de la dgur grangs nges pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ byangaṃ chubaṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam mnyam gzhag chos can/ khyod la chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs dgur grangs nges te/ khyod kyi spang bya rnam rtog de la chen po'i chen po sogs dgur grangs nges pa'i phyir/ deṃ ltaraṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam mnyam gzhag chos can/ khyod rgyun chags su byung ste/ khams gsum sa dgu'i rnam rtog chen po'i chen po sogs dgu rnam pas cig char spong ba'i sgo nas chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs dgu rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ngo bo zab pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ don dam gyi byed pa la rtsod pa spang ba/ kun rdzob kyi byed pa la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'bras bu skyed pa mi 'thad par thal ba spang ba/ bya ba byed pa mi 'thad pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyalaṃ ba'iṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ khyod la dgur grangs ma nges par thal/ khyod kyi 'bras bu dgu las mang ba'i phyir te/ khyod re res kyang 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med sogs bskyed pa rgyal ba'i yum las gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa ltar na gnyis las/ rtsod pa ni/ grangasaṃ medaṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med sogs bskyed pa mi 'thad par thal/ don dam par zab mo stong nyid yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan ni/ kunaṃ rdzobaṃ de chos can/ don dam par zab mo stong nyid yin yang kun rdzob tu bsod nams grangs med sogs bskyed par mi 'gal te/ don dam par zab mo stong nyid yin kyang kun rdzob du bsod nams grangs med sogs khyod kyi thugs rje'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni mtshams sbyar gyi lan du sbyar te/ grangasaṃ medaṃ de chos can/ don dam par bsod nams grangs med gzhal med sogs bskyed pa'i sgo nas dgur grangs ma nges par thal ba'i skyon med de/ don dam par bsod nams grangs med sogs stong nyid sogasaṃ kyi ngo bo yin pas tha dad du med pa'i phyir/

kunaṃ rdzobaṃ de chos can/ kun rdzob tu 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med sogs bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la dgur grangs ma nges par thal ba'i skyon med de/ kun rdzob tu khyod kyi 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med sogs kyis dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis tshogs gnyis bsgoms pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yin gyi khyod kyi ngo bo ma yin pas ngo bo'i grangs nges la mi gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang lan no/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ stongaṃ paṃ dngos po brjod du med pa la zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ don dam par stong nyid yin na/ spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba byed par mi rung ngo snyam pa'i dogs pa bsu ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dngosaṃ dang chosaṃ de chos can/ spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba byed par mi rung bar thal/ sgom pa phul du byung ba byar med pa'i phyir te/ don dam par zab mo stong nyid kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ bsaṃ de chos can/ spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba byed pa'i ched du khyod ston pa'i gzhung nye bar dgod par mi bya ba kho na yin par thal/ spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba mi byed pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ byangaṃ chubaṃ theg pa chen po'i sgom lam chos can/ khyod don dam par stong nyid yin yang kun rdzob du spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba byed pa'i dpe yang dag yod de/ sku gsum po don dam par gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral yang kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gyi spros par bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don byed pa de khyod de ltar byed pa'i dpe yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ kun rdzob tu ma nges pa'i lan dang / don dam du 'dod pa'i lan no/

/dang po la gnyis te/ dpe sgrub pa dang / don la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ sku gsum po chos can/ don dam par gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral yang kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gyi spros par bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa mi 'gal te/ don dam par gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral yang / kun rdzob tu gdul bya'i skye bo rnams kyis tshogs gnyis kyi rjes su mthun par gzugs sku khyad par can snang ba'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgomaṃ lamaṃ pasaṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ don dam par stong nyid yin yang kun rdzob tu spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba byed pa mi 'gal te/ de ltar byed pa'i mthun dpe yang dag yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ donaṃ dmaṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ don dam par spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba mi byed par thal/ don dam par zab mo stong nyid kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa la gnod byed kyi thal 'gyur yang dag ma yin par thal/ dbu ma pas khyod la 'dod lan don mthun du thebs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa kun rdzob kyi byed pa la rtsod pa spong ba la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang / lan no/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sems ni snga mas zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg pa chen po'i sgom lam des kun rdzob tu yang byang chub skyed par mi rigs so snyam pa'i dogs pa bsu ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ semasaṃ dang sngaṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ skad cig snga phyi gang rung re re kho nas byang chub bskyed par rigs pa ma yin te/ skad cig snga phyi gang rung re re kho na la byang chub bsgrub pa'i rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dodaṃ pa'iṃ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi sems bskyed chos can/ rigs mthun du ma cig char 'byung bas byang chub bskyed par rigs pa ma yin te/

rigs mthun du ma cig char 'byung ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /blaṃ naṃ de chos can/ rim gyis 'byung ba du mas byang chub bskyed par rigs pa ma yin te/ snga phyi phan tshun 'brel ba med pa'i phyir te/ phyi ma byung ma thag tu snga ma 'jig pa'i phyir/ deṃ bsaṃ bla na med pa'i byang chub chos can/ khyod kyis don khyad par can snang ba'i sems bskyed pa'i sgo nas don byed pa ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi rgyus khyod bskyed pa'i tshul la brtags na mi 'thad pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ niṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ maraṃ meṃ theg chen sgom lam gyi sems bskyed chos can/ khyod kyis byang chub bskyed tshul mtha' gsum du brtags na mi 'thad pa'i skyon med de/ khyod kyis byang chub bskyed tshul gyi mtha' phyi ma'i bsgrub byed de la mar mes sdong bu snum ldan bsreg pa'i dpes khyab pa ma nges pa'i lan thebs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ dpe sgrub pa/ don la sbyar ba/ don gzhan yang mtshon pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ltos med du mi bsreg pa/ ltos nas bsreg pa/ de gnyis ka'i don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ skad cig dang pos ltos med du mi bsreg pa/ de gnyis pas ltos med du mi bsreg pa'o/ /dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ mar me'i me lce skad cig dang po chos can/ me lce skad cig gnyis pa la ma ltos par sdong bu snum ldan mi bsreg ste/ me lce skad cig gnyis pa la ma ltos par sdong bu snum ldan bsreg nus kyi nus pa khyad par can du ma skyes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ niṃ mar me'i me lce skad cig gnyis pa chos can/ mar me'i me lce skad cig dang po la ma ltos par sdong bu snum ldan mi bsreg ste/ mar me'i me lce skad cig gnyis pa la ma ltos par kun rdzob tu yang 'byung ba med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gangaṃ giṃ mar me'i me lce chos can/

skad cig snga phyi phan tshun ltos nas sdong bu snum ldan bsreg ste/ skad cig snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma sdong bu snum ldan bsreg nus kyi nus pa khyad par can du byas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ bsaṃ mar me'i me lce chos can/ skad cig snga phyi phan tshun ma ltos par sdong bu snum ldan mi bsreg ste/ de ltar bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skadaṃ cigaṃ theg chen sgom lam gyi sems bskyed chos can/ skad cig snga phyi phan tshun ltos nas byang chub thob par rigs te/ skad cig snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma byang chub thob pa'i nus pa khyad par can du byas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ jiṃ skadaṃ mar me'i me lces sdong bu snum ldan bsreg pa'i dpe chos can/ don gzhan yang mtshon nus te/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad kyang mi 'gal bar mtshon nus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gtan tshigs zab pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgomaṃ pa'iṃ zab mo rnam pa brgyad gang la yod pa'i yul dang bcas pa bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg chen sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skyeṃ baṃ theg chen sgom lam pa chos can/ khyod phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs zab mo rnam pa brgyad yod de/ khyod phyir mi ldog par bsgrub pa'i gtan tshigs zab mo la yul skye 'gag zab pa gnyis/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid zab pa gcig spang bya gzung 'dzin zab pa gnyis/ nyams len spyod pa zab pa gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ skadaṃ cigaṃ theg chen sgom lam pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can de chos can/ skye ba zab pa yin te/ skye ba zab pa rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag gis drangs pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ /bsamaṃ gyisaṃ theg chen sgom lam pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can chos can/

zab mo yin te/ 'gal ba ltar snang yang mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas rtog ge'i blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ngo bo'i sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ slobaṃ paṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo la gsum ste/ chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ phrin las kyi rgyu thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ slobaṃ pa'iṃ byams mgon chos can/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs kyi 'og tu srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob nas srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba sgom dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chosaṃ rnamasaṃ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba yin te/ rjes thob du yang 'khor 'das la blang dor tha dad du ma ིrtog par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ laṃs meṃd 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams rmi lam dang 'dra ba chos can/ khyod la chos mthun gyi klan ka med de/ khyod kyi klan ka'i lan mdo las bsal zin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang klan ka spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khoraṃ baṃ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ klan ka dang lan no/ /dang po ni/ rmiṃ lamaṃ gnyid ma log pa'i gnas skabs na chos can/ dge mi dge'i las med par thal/ rmi lam dang 'dra ba nyid yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rtags ma nges par bstan pa/ dpe ma grub par bstan pa/ klan ka bsal bas grub pa'i don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dpe sgrub/ don la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ don dam skad cig ma la dge sdig gi las ma grub pa/ kun rdzob rgyun la ltos nas dge sdig gi las grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ nyan thos sde gnyis kyi lugs la yang don dam skad cig ma la chos can/

srog gcod kyi las med de/ bsad bya'i srog rang rgyu las rgyu gzhan med par rang gi ngang gis 'jigs pa'i phyir dang / las kyi dbang gis bsad bya'i srog 'gag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ srog gcod spangs pa'i dge ba yod pa min te/ srog gcod kyi las med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyunaṃ 'jugaṃ kun rdzob rgyun la chos can/ dge sdig gi las yod de/ tshul min yid byed kyis kun nas bslangs te/ srog gi rgyun 'jug pa dang 'gal ba'i dngos po bskyed pa la srog gcod kyi las dang tshul bzhin yid byed kyi sgo nas mi dge ba'i rgyun 'jug pa dang 'gal ba'i dngos po bskyed pa la dge bar 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos po dbu ma pa la'ang chos can/ don dam par dge sdig gi las med kyang kun rdzob tu dge sdig gi las 'jog pa mi 'gal te/ de ltar 'jog pa'i mthun dpe yang dag yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nyi shu pa'i lung gis ma grub par bstan pa/ sher phyin gyi lung gis ma grub par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhanaṃ yangaṃ rmi lam chos can/ khyod kun rdzob tu las med pa'i dper ma grub ste/ nyi shu pa las khyod kyi gnas skabs na las dman pa sogs pa yod par gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ bzhinaṃ niṃ gzhi chos 'dra/ sher phyin gyi mdo las khyod kyi gnas skabs na las spyad par rmis pa de sad pa'i gnas skabs su gsos btab na las sogs par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'khoraṃ baṃ don dam par 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid yin te/ don dam par 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa na chos mthun gyi klan ka med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyisaṃ kaṃ byams mgon chos can/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i 'og tu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ srid zhi mnyam nyid du sgom pa'i gang zag de zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'i 'bras bu mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ semasaṃ dang semasaṃ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ snod bcud kyi zhing ma dag pa'i gnyen por snod bcud kyi zhing dag pa so sor sgom pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rangaṃ giṃ byams mgon chos can/ zhing dag sbyor gyi 'og tu thabs mkhas sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa'i gang zag de thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i 'bras bu la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yulaṃ dngaṃ thabs mkhas sbyor ba chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcu yod de/ khyod kyi yul thabs mkhas de la bcu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la yang bcur phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ yul thabs mkhas bshad pa dang / yul can sbyor ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ b.raṃ chadaṃ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ bdud las 'das pa'i thabs la mkhas pa yin te/ bdud bzhi ma lus par spangs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shesaṃ rabaṃ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ yul thabs mkhas bcu po mngon sum du bya ba'i dus dang dus ma yin pa shes nas dus la ma babs pa na mngon du mi byed cing / dus la babs pa na mngon du byed pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas 'jug bsdu ba ni/ shesaṃ rabaṃ sogs so// //gnyis pa dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la gsum ste/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ byams mgon chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i 'og tu rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bsgoms pa las bsgom bya'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i rtse sbyor 'byung ba'i phyir/
