gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor/ mthong lam rtse sbyor/ sgom lam rtse sbyor/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rtags kyis mtshon pa'i rtse sbyor/ rnam 'phel gyis mtshon pa'i rtse sbyor/ brtan pa gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i rtse sbyor/ sems kun tu gnas pas mtshon pa'i rtse sbyor ro/ /dang po la gnyis las/ rtsa ba ni/ rmiṃ lamaṃ byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes chos can/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor yin te/ rtse sbyor thob pa'i rtags bcu gnyis kyis mtshon nas mdo las dngos su bstan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa ni/ shinaṃ tuṃ drod la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chos can/ rtse sbyor thob pa yin te/ shin tu goms pa'i dbang gis rmi lam gyi gnas skabs na yang chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ba la sogs par blta ba'i phyir/ des 'og ma lnga la 'gre/ grongaṃ khyeraṃ chos can dang chos 'dra/ bdag byang chub tu lung bstan na me 'di zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod pas grong khyer la sogs pa tshig pa zhi bar byed pa'i bden pa'i byin rlabs grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma lnga la 'gre/ zhesaṃ byaṃ de chos can/ khyod kyis rtse sbyor thob pa'i rtags bcu gnyis yod de/ khyod kyis rtse sbyor thob pa'i rmi lam gyi rtags drug sad pa'i rtags drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dzamaṃ buṃ rtse mo la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs chos can/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor yin te/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba bcu drug gis mtshon nas mdo las dngos su bstan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dzamaṃ bu'iṃ byang sems kyi sbyor lam rtse mo chos can/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba yin te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi sems can snyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa las khyod kyi bsod nams lhag pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba yin te/ khyad par du rtse mo'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yid la byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ /meṃ togaṃ sbyor lam rtse mo'i bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba chos can/ khyod la bcu drug yod de/ khyod la phyi gtso bor gyur pa'i bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba brgyad/ nang gtso bor gyur pa'i bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ rnam 'phel gyi 'og tu nges par brtan pa 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam 'phel mthar phyin pa las nges par brtan pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kunaṃ mkhyenaṃ bzod pa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi mngon par rtogs pa chos can/ brtan pa'i rtse sbyor yin te/ brtan pa gnyis kyis mtshon nas mdo las dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byang sems kyi sbyor lam bzod pa chos can/ gzhan don phrin las brtan pa yin te/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong ba'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ rnamaṃ paṃ de chos can/ rang don rtogs pa brtan pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi chos yongs su rdzogs par bsngo ba bla na med pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ brtan pa'i 'og tu sems kun tu gnas pa 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ brtan pa gnyis po mthar phyin pa las sems kun tu gnas par 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ glingaṃ dang tshadaṃ byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ sems kun gnas kyi rtse sbyor yin te/ stong gsum gyi sa rdo'i grangs dang / chu thigs kyi grangs las ches cher khyad par du 'phags shing tshad las 'das pa'i bsod nams mang po'i sgo nas mdo las dngos su bstan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ rtagasaṃ rtags kyi rtse sbyor sogs bzhi po chos can/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor yin te/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi sngon du byung ba'i rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos so/ /dang po ni/ ngesaṃ paraṃ byams mgon chos can/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor gyi 'og tu mthong lam rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spang bya rnam rtog gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ gnyen po'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzung rtog mdor bstan/ 'dzin rtog mdor bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ byams mgon chos can/ mthong spangs rtog pa bzhi'i nang nas gzung rtog gnyis thog mar ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de ston pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jugaṃ dang 'jugaṃ gzung rtog chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ nyonaṃ mongasaṃ mthong spang gzung rtog gnyis po chos can/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin te/ de skye ba'i gegs byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ soṃ dang yulaṃ gzung rtog gnyis po chos can/ so sor dgu dgu yod de/ yul dgu dgu yod pa'i dbye bas so sor dgu dgur phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ jiṃ dang dngosaṃ gzung rtog gnyis po chos can/ yul gyi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ma yin te/ de la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ soṃ dang soṃ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi skyes bu rdzas su yod pa'i rten can gyi 'dzin rtog dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi skyes bu btags par yod pa'i rten can gyi 'dzin rtog gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

gangaṃ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gnyis chos can/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin te/ mthong lam rtse sbyor skye ba'i gegs byed pa'i phyir/ deṃ dang yulaṃ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gnyis chos can/ so sor dgu dgu yod de/ yul dgu dgu yod pa'i dbye bas so sor dgu dgur phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ dang gangaṃ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gnyis chos can/ yul gyi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ma yin te/ de phyin ci log du snang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ gzung rtog rgyas par bshad/ 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'jug pa gzung rtog rgyas par bshad/ ldog pa gzung rtog rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzungaṃ ba'iṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngoṃ boṃ byang sems kyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la 'jug bya mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ 'jug pa gzung rtog yin te/ rang yul theg chen gyi 'jug bya'i gzung ba la dmigs nas 'jug bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i spang bya rnam rtog yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dbenaṃ pasaṃ 'jug pa gzung rtog gi 'jug bya'i bzung ba chos can/ dgu yod de/ byang sems kyi lam gyi dbang du byas pa lnga 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ skyonaṃ medaṃ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ mthongaṃ ba'iṃ 'jug pa gzung rtog dgu po chos can/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi sbyor ba'i gnas skabs kyi spang bya yin te/ de'i gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzungaṃ ba'iṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sridaṃ dang theg dman gyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la dmigs nas dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ ldog pa gzung rtog yin te/ rang yul theg dman gyi ldog bya'i gzung ba la dmigs nas dor byar mngon par zhen pa'i spang bya rnam rtog yin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ 'khoraṃ baṃ ldog pa gzung rtog gi ldog bya'i bzung ba chos can/ dgu yod de/ theg dman gyi lam gyi dbang du byas pa lnga/ 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ nyesaṃ paṃ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ nyanaṃ thosaṃ ji skad bshad pa'i yul dgu po chos can/ nyan rang la ltos nas ldog bya ma yin te/ de la ltos nas blang bya yin pa'i phyir/ byangaṃ chubaṃ ldog pa gzung rtog dgu po chos can/ mthong ba'i lam gyi 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi spang bya yin te/ de'i gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa rgyas par bshad/ btags 'dzin rtog pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po gsum las/ dang po ni/ soṃ so'iṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dziṃn paṃ 'dzin dor sogs yul dgu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa yin te/ rang yul rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ kunaṃ rdzobaṃ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i yul du gyur pa'i 'dzin pa chos can/ dgu yod de/ gtso bo sher phyin gyi dbang du byas pa brgyad/ phar phyin gzhan lnga'i dbang du byas pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ donaṃ dmaṃ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ mthoṃng baṃ'i ci skad bshad pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dgu chos can/ snga mas 'gre/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'dziṃn paṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ chedaṃ bzhiṃn ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung ba sogs yul dgu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ btags 'dzin rtog pa yin te/ rang yul btags yod kyi 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i spang bya rnam rtog yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyaṃn thosaṃ btags 'dzin rtog pa'i yul du gyur pa'i 'dzin pa chos can/

dgu yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ byang sems kyi lam gyi dbang du byas pa drug so so skye bo tha mal pa'i dbang du byas pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ btagaṃs paṃ'i rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ mthoṃng baṃ'i ci skad bshad pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa dgu chos can/ snga mas 'gre'o/ /gsum pa gnyen po'i dbye ba ni/ deṃ ltaṃr mthong spangs rtog pa chos can/ khyod kyi gnyen po bzhi po re re la yang spang bya'i sgo nas dgu dgur dbyer rung ste/ khyod bzhi po re re la yang dgu dgur yod pas de ltar dbyer rung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor la gnyis te/ zhar las byung ba'i don dang / rnal ma mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ byang chub chen po'i rgyu dang / 'bras bu byang chub chen po'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byang chub chen po 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu gsum bde blag du rtogs par byed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ byaṃng chuṃb byang chub chen po'i rgyu chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ gzhan 'bras bu rtogs pa'i cha la 'god pa/ rgyu lung gi chos la 'god pa/ rang nyid byang chub kyi rgyu la sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'chaṃd paṃr gzhan 'bras bu rtogs pa'i chos la 'god pa chos can/ byang chub chen po'i rgyu yin te/ byang chub chen po thob par byed pa'i dge rtsa yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma gnyis la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dbu ma pa'i byang chub 'dod tshul brjod/ dngos smra ba'i byang chub 'dod tshul dgag grol ba 'dod pas stong nyid la 'jug par gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ gaṃng giṃ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ rgyu gsum las byung ba'i byang chen bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ driṃ maṃ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ byang chub yin te/ mthong spang rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma gdod ma nas zad pa la zad pa dang mi skye ba la mi skye bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ zadaṃ medaṃ mthong spang rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma chos can/ gdod ma nas zad pa dang / mi skye ba yin te/ gdod ma nas yod pa gnyen pos gsar du zad pa med pa'i phyir dang / sngar med bden pa ba gsar du skye ba med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyonaṃ mongaṃs mthong spangs sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma chos can du bzung nas/ rtsa ba'i chos rtags phyi ma 'god/ goṃ rimaṃ sku gsum po chos can/ byang chub chen po yin te/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma gdod ma nas zad pa la zad pa dang / mi skye ba la mi skye bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthar thug gi byang chub yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos po'i rigs pas dgag pa dang / khas blangs 'gal bas dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gaṃng giṃ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la la zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dri ma bden grub yod na zad dang mi skye shes pa'i byang chub mi rung ngo zhes bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'goṃg dang skyeṃ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mthong spang rtog pa zad pa bden grub zad pa dang / de zad pa'i 'gog pa thob pa mi 'thad par thal/ mthong spangs rtog pa bden grub med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dngos smra bas dri ma bden grub du khas len pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi sgrib gnyis dri ma spangs par khas blangs pa la khas blangs nang 'gal bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ gzhaṃn gyiṃ sems tsam pa chos can/ dbu ma pas bzhad gad kyi gnas yin te/ dri ma bden par grub pa dang ston pas sgrib gnyis spangs par khas blangs pa'i rgol ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ dbu ma pa la dri ma spong ba 'thad pa'i tshul/ dngos smra ba la de mi 'thad pa'i tshul/ rtsa ba'i tshig don dngos 'chad pa'o/ /dang po la rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi las/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa ni/ deṃ laṃ nyer len gyi phung po gang zag gi bdag gis stong par rtogs nas sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor de chos can/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa yin te/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gtso bor spong bar byed pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa ni/ sngonaṃ poṃ lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags las bzung ba phyi rol gyi don med par rtogs nas sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor chos can/ bzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa yin te/ bzung ba phyi rol gyi don la bden 'dzin gtso bor spong bar byed pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa ni/ gzuṃng baṃ bzung ba med na de la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa med par rtogs nas sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor chos can/ 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa yin te/ nang 'dzin pa la bden 'dzin gtso bor spong bar byed pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa ni/ deṃ yaṃng mtha' bzhi'i spros bral rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi bar chad med lam chos can/ spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa yin te/ rang gi ngos skal gyi shes sgrib kyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/

deṃ ltaṃr de lta ma yin par sgrib gnyis bden par grub na sgrib gnyis chos can/ khyod gnyen po bsgoms pas spong mi nus par thal/ khyod rang skyed du med pa dang / gnyen pos spong du med pa'i rang gi ngo bo 'dzin pa'i phyir/ dper na nam mkha' rdzas med pa tsam gyi ngo bo rtag du 'dzin pa'i rdzas med pa tsam gyi ngo bo 'dor du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ de'iṃ phyiraṃ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god do/ /gsum pa grol ba 'dod pas stong nyid la 'jug par gdams pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg chen gyi thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis dri ma gdod ma nas zad skye med pa khas blang dgos par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃ laṃ dri ma gdod ma nas yod pa gnyen pos gsar du zad pa med pa dang / dri ma spangs pa'i 'gog bden gsar du bzhag par bya ba med pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba bsgoms pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ phyin ci log gi 'ching ba las rnam par grol ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gaṃng giṃ gzugs sogs yang dag kun rdzob chos can/ khyod la snang ba'i ngo bo bsal ba dang / bden pa'i ngo bo bzhag pa ma byas par lta dgos te/ khyod la snang ba'i ngo bo bsal ba dang / bden pa'i ngo bo bzhag pa byas na bden 'dzin las mi grol ba'i phyir/ rangaṃ bzhinaṃ de chos can/ khyod la rang bzhin med pa la sogs par brtag par bya ba yin te/ khyod la rang bzhin med pa la sogs par brtags pas gnas lugs mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /deṃ ltaṃr gzugs sogs kyi de kho na nyid mthong ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ phyin ci log las grol ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnal ma mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos la gsum ste/ bar chad med lam pa'i lam/ rnam grol gyi lam/ khyad par gyi lam mo/

/dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyinaṃ dang sbyinaṃ phar phyin re re yang phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mthong ba'i lam yin te/ mthong spangs sgrib gnyis kyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ skyesaṃ byang sems kyi mthong lam skad cig phyi ma bco lnga po chos can/ mthong lam rnam grol lam yin te/ mthong lam mnyam gzhag gang zhig mthong spangs ma lus par spangs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ laṃ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi gnas skabs su thob pa'i yon tan la dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang dang yang du bsgom par byed dgos so zhes shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ dang mthongaṃ sa dang po'i byang sems kyis seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ seng ge rnam bsgyings la dbang thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ rtenaṃ dang dusaṃ sa dang po'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su rten 'brel lugs mthun dang lugs bzlog tu bsgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras sdug kun gyi bden pa dang / myang 'das rgyu 'bras 'gog lam gyi bden pa la mkhas pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la gsum ste/ rten sgom lam/ spang bya rnam rtog brten pa yon tan no/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i sgom lam dang / brten pa yon tan gyi rten bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ 'goṃg dngaṃ byang sems sgom lam pas dngos gzhi thod rgal chung ngu dang 'bring gnyis bsgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dngos gzhi thod rgal chen po thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ 'ongaṃ nasaṃ byang sems sgom lam pas dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po'i rjes su srid rtse'i nud chung byed pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyang ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ 'doṃd paṃr byang sems sgom lam pas mtshams 'dzin gyi 'dod sems mngon du byed pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ thod rgal 'bring po'i 'gog pa dang thod rgal chen po'i 'gog pa gnyis kyi mtshams phyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ thodaṃ rgaṃl byang sems sgom lam pas dngos gzhi thod rgal chen po sgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sgom lam mnyam gzhag gi rtsal sbyang ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / don bsdus te thod rgal gyi ngo bor bstan pa dang / rten bsgom lam gyi ngo bor bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug go /dang po ni/ byangaṃ chuṃb byang sems sgom lam pas sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dngos gzhi thod rgal la snyoms par 'jug nus pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po/ mtshams 'dzin gyi 'dod sems/ dngos gzhi thod rgal chen po'o/ /dang po ni/ yangaṃ bsaṃm byang sems sgom lam pas mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug brgyad la 'gog pa brgyad spel nas bsgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ chos gzhan spel nas lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rigs la dbang thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ laṃs rtsa ba'i nud chung gi sbyor ba 'god/ gnyis pa ni/ 'doṃd paṃ rtsa ba'i mtshams 'dzin gyi sbyor ba 'god/ gsum pa ni/

deṃ'i 'oṃg byang sems sgom lam pas mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la 'dod sems dgu spel nas lugs bzlog tu snyoms par 'jug pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ chos gzhan spel nas lugs bzlog tu snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rigs la dbang thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaṃr mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la 'dod sems dgu spel nas lugs bzlog tu snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mnyam rjes rigs mi 'dra ba spel ba'i sgo nas lugs bzlog tu snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dgaṃ paṃ dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug chos can/ rten bsgom lam yin te/ sgom spangs shes sgrib kyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i sgom lam mnyam gzhag gi rten grub pa'i ched du bsgom pa'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa spang bya rnam rtog la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rgyas par bshad pa/ gnyen po'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi skabs su spang bya rnam rtog bzhi bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gzung rtog rgyas par bshad pa/ 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sbyor ba'i yul can gyi gzung rtog dang / 'jug pa'i yul can gyi gzung rtog go /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ reṃ zhiṃg sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdoṃr dang bsduṃs bzlog pa dang rnal ma ci rigs par sbyor ba'i yul dgu la dmigs nas 'jug bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ sbyor ba'i yul can gyi gzung rtog yin te/ rang yul sbyor ba'i rnam pa la dmigs nas 'jug bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i spang bya rnam rtog yin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ mdoṃr bsduṃs sbyor ba'i yul can gyi gzung rtog gi yul chos can/ rnam pa dgu yod de/ rnal mar sbyor ba gnyis/ bzlog par sbyor ba bzhi/ slar yang rnal mar sbyor ba gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bzuṃng baṃ'i rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ gnaṃs skabaṃs sbyor ba'i yul can gyi gzung rtog dgu po chos can/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi sbyor ba'i gnas skabs kyi spang bya yin te/ de'i gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnyiṃs paṃ nyan rang gi sems sems byung gi rgyun 'jug pa la dmigs nas ldog bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ 'jug pa'i yul can gyi gzung rtog yin te/ rang yul 'jug pa la dmigs nas ldog bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i spang bya rnam rtog yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dgeṃ baṃ'i 'jug pa'i yul can gyi gzung rtog gi yul chos can/ rnam pa dgu yod de/ nyan rang gi tshogs kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ sbyor lam gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum gyi re re sgom mi sgom las bzlog pa dang / shes bya ma gtogs pa'i dbang du byas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bzuṃng baṃ'i rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ gnaṃs skabaṃs 'jug pa'i yul can gyi gzung rtog dgu po chos can/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi 'jug pa bar chad med lam gyi spang bya yin te/ de'i gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ sems can du gdags pa la brten pa dang / gdags pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ semaṃs canaṃ sems can du btags pa sogs yul dgu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ sems can du btags pa la brten pa'i 'dzin rtog yin te/ sgom spangs rtog pa gang zhig

sems can du btags pa sogs yul dgu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rdzasaṃ suṃ sgom spangs 'dzin rtog dang po'i yul chos can/ dgu yod de/ shes bya'i dbang du byas pa gsum/ nyan rang dang / byang sems kyi shes rab gnyis/ thabs gnyis/ so so skye bo'i lta spyod gnyis rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sngaṃ maṃ rtsa ba'i ngag don 'god/ sgomaṃ paṃ'i gzung rtog dang pos 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems dang miṃ ma rig pa dgu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo chos can/ sgom spangs 'dzin rtog gnyis pa yin te/ sgom spangs rtog pa gang zhig sems can du gdags pa'i rgyu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdagaṃ nyidaṃ mdor bstan gyi ngag don 'god/ gsum pa ni/ rnamaṃ paṃ sgom spangs 'dzin rtog gnyis pa'i yul chos can/ rnam pa dgu yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgrib pa la rmongs pa sogs ma rig pa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ sngaṃ maṃ mdor bstan gyi ngag don 'god/ sgomaṃ paṃ'i bzung rtog gnyis pas 'gre'o/ /gsum pa gnyen po'i dbye ba ni/ sgomaṃ paṃ'i sgom spangs gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi po chos can/ khyod kyi gnyen po bzhi po re re la yang spang bya'i sgo nas dgu dgur yod de/ khyod bzhi po re re la yang dgu dgur yod pas de ltar dbye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa brten pa yon tan la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngaṃ maṃ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sgom spangs gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa mngon 'gyur brgya rtsa brgyad spangs pa na theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs kyi yon tan bar ma chad du brten par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ yamaṃs dang sgomaṃ dag sa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs kyi yon tan bar ma chad du brten pa yin te/ de brten pa la gegs byed pa'i mtshan 'dzin spangs pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la gnyis te/ dngos dang / dmigs rnam mo/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgom pa'i byams mgon chos can/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi 'og tu bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sgom lam rtse sbyor sngon du song nas bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ stongaṃ dang 'gaṃ' sa bcu rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor yin te/ dngos 'bras rnam mkhyen bsod nams mang po'i sgo nas mdo las dngos su bstan pa'i sbas don gyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dmigs rnam dngos dang / bsal bya log par sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de'iṃ dmiṃgs 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de/ zhes sogs gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃ dang baṃr chos thams cad bden pa'i dngos po med pa de chos can/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs pa'i rkyen yin te/ bar chad med rtse de khyod la dmigs nas skye ba'i phyir/ bdaṃg dang bdaṃg rgyun mtha' man chad kyi mkhyen gsum gyi dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa chos can/ bar chad med rtse'i bdag po'i rkyen yin te/ de rang dbang du skye byed yin pa'i phyir/ rnamaṃ dang rnamaṃ bar chad med rtse chos can/ zhi ba'i rnam pa can yin te/ spros bral gyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsal bya log par sgrub pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'diṃ dang gnasaṃ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam chos can/

khyod la rtog ge pa rnams klan ka 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod rtog ge pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba'i zab mo'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ thabaṃs laṃ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam gyi gnas la klan ka chos can/ khyod thabs la mkhas pas bsal bar bya ba yin te/ khyod la thabs la mi mkhas pa'i klan ka yin pa'i phyir/ 'disaṃ niṃ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam la klan ka 'byung bar bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ de'i dmigs rnam zab par rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ blo'iṃ noraṃ bar chad med rtse'i 'og tu log rtog bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ log rtog bsal nas bar chad med rtse'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed tshul bde blag du rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dmigaṃs paṃ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam la log par rtog pa'i log rtog chos can/ khyod la bcu drug yod de/ khyod kyi yul de la bcu drug yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la bcu drug du phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ bsal bya klan ka bsal nas ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'dusaṃ byaṃs 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi khams bden pa'i dngos por med pas kun rdzob du rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa mi 'thad snyam pa'i log rtog chos can/ khyod bsal bya log rtog yin te/ khyod don dam du med na kun rdzob du yang med dgos so snyam pa'i don dam sgo can gyi log rtog yin pa'i phyir/ log rtog des kun nas bslangs pa'i klan ka chos can/ khyod bsal bya klan ka yin te/ khyod don dam gyi khas blangs rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa'i don dam sgo can gyi klan ka yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ /skyeṃ boṃ skabs 'dir bstan gyi log rtog bcu drug bstan pa'i mdo chos can/ dngos rgyu bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam la brten pa'i log rtog shugs la bstan pa yin te/

dngos 'bras rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs rnam la log rtog dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ baṃs bar chad med rtse'i ting nge 'dzin 'dod pa'i byang sems chos can/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam la log par rtog pa'i log rtog bsal dgos te/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam la nges pa skyed pa'i sgo nas bar chad med rtse'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni shesaṃ rabaṃ sogs so// //gsum pa brtan pa thob pa'i don du bsgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la gsum ste/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtseṃ moṃ'i byams mgon chos can/ rtse sbyor gyi 'og du mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtse sbyor gyi gnas skabs su rtogs pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa mthar gyis pas go rim du bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la rtsa ba dang / 'grel pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyiṃn paṃ sbyin pa'i phar phyin nas dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi bar bcu gsum po chos can/ tshogs lam du mthar gyis pa'i bya ba yin te/ der thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba yin pas mthar gyis par 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sbyor lam du mthar gyis pa slob pa yin te/ der rgyun ldan du sgom par bya ba yin pas mthar gyis par 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de chos can/ mthong sgom gyi gnas skabs su mthar gyis sgrub pa yin te/ der mngon sum du rtogs par bya ba yin pas mthar gyis par 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa/ rnam par dag byed kyi chos so/ /dang po ni/ phaṃ rolaṃ sa dang po'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim bzhin du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor chos can/

sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyis zin pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim bzhin du bklags nas brtan por bya ba'i phyir sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan lnga la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dranaṃ paṃ de chos can/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pas zin pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim bzhin du bklags nas brtan por bya ba'i phyir sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan lnga la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzuṃgs laṃs de chos can/ dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ chos thams cad bden pa'i dngos po med par rtogs pas zin pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim bzhin du bklags nas brtan por bya ba'i phyir/ sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag las mthar gyis pa dang / mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i khyad par ni/ mthar gyis bya ba sogs tshogs lam nas 'jog kyang mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sa dang po nas 'jog tshul shes pa gal che bas de blo yul du ma shar bar du rang gi rna ba tshad mar mi bya'o/ /gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni shesaṃ rabaṃ sogs so// //bzhi pa brtan pa thob nas cig char bsgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la gsum ste/ 'grel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mthaṃr gyisaṃ byams mgon chos can/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i 'og tu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor bas bsgoms pa'i rnam pa skad cig ma'i sbyor bas cig char du sgom dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/

rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos dang / de'i dpe'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ yangaṃ byams mgon chos can/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi'i nang nas rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang por 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de 'chad pa bshad pa'i rim pa yin pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma gsum la'ang 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyinaṃ dang luṃgs rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig sgom pa'i tshe de dang ris mthun pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs thams cad cig char bsgom nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yangaṃ jiṃ ltaṃr sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ dang dpeṃr rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyis zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig bsgoms pa'i tshe de dang ris mthun pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs thams cad sgom nus pa chos can/ khyod kyi mthun dpe yang dag yod de/ skyes bu'i rdog thabs gcig gis skyod pa na zo chun gyi rgyud thams cad cig char 'gul ba de khyod kyi mthun dpe yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gangaṃ dang gangaṃ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig bsgom pa na de dang ris mthun pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs thams cad sgom nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyinaṃ dang sngonaṃ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/

kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi chos thams cad bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rmiṃ dang yulaṃ canaṃ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par skad cig ma gcig kho na la mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni shesaṃ rabaṃ sogs so// //gsum pa 'bras bu chos kyi sku la gsum ste/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ byams mgon chos can/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i 'og du 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnam par bsgom pa'i skad cig ma gnyis pa la 'bras bu chos sku 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rten sku bshad pa/ brten pa phrin las bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ ye shes chos kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ yangaṃ byams mgon chos can/ sku bzhi'i nang nas dang por ngo bo nyid sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku de sku gzhan gsum gyi rten yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ thubaṃ paṃ'i sangs rgyas sa'i chos nyid kyi sku de chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku yin te/ zag med kyi ye shes dang / dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings dbyer med pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi sku yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo nyid sku'i rang bzhin/ sku lhag ma gsum po tha dad du bstan pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thubaṃ pa dran pa nyer bzhag sogs ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi chos nyid chos can/

ngo bo nyid sku yin te/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir/ bcoṃs maṃ ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis 'thob pa yin gyi ngo bo gsar du byas pa ma yin te/ rgyu rkyen gyis ma bcos pa'i mthar thug gi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sku lhag chos can gyi sku gsum po chos can/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang tha mi dad kyang kun rdzob du tha dad du rnam par bzhag pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sangs rgyas dang / byang sems dang / nyan thos la sogs pa'i spyod yul du so sor snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sku la sku gsum so sor bzhag pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ de la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ye shes dang sku tha dad du bstan pa/ tha mi dad du 'dod pa dgag pa/ tha dad du bstan pa la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr byams mgon chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku'i 'og tu ye shes chos sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ye shes chos sku de gzugs sku gnyis su snang ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byaṃng chuṃb byang phyogs so bdun sogs ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig po chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku'i yon tan yin te/ ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid gsum gyi nang nas dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i zag med kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i 'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ yon tan so sor bshad pa/ thams cad chos skur bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ thun mong gi yon tan gyi sde tshan/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi sde tshan no/ /dang po ni/ draṃn paṃ sangs rgyas sa'i byang phyogs so bdun chos can/ ye shes chos sku yin te/ gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/

mngon par shes pa drug gi bar la 'gre ste/ chos can la sangs rgyas sa'i zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ soṃ soṃ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi chos can/ ye shes chos sku yin te/ gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la 'gre ste/ chos can rang ldog nas bzung bas chog go /gnyis pa ni/ byaṃng chuṃb sangs rgyas sa'i byang phyogs so bdun sogs ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig po chos can/ chos rtags 'gre/ gnyis pa tha mi dad du 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ phyogs snga ma brjod/ de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhaṃn daṃg sku gsum du 'dod pa dag na re/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni zhes pa nas chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad drug po chos can/ khyod kyis ngo bo nyid sku ston pa yin te/ khyod kyi tshigs bcad dang pos ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid gsum ldan du bstan/ tshigs bcad phyi ma rnams kyis mtshan nyid gsum gyi nang nas zag med kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir zhes zer/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhaṃn daṃg sku bzhir 'dod pa dag na re/ sangs rgyas kyi sku thams cad sku gsum du bsdus na sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba de chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi skus ma bsdus par thal/ sku gsum po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /gsum pa tha dad du bstan pa la rtsod pa spong ba la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ khaṃ cigaṃ sku gsum du 'dod pa dag na re/ sangs rgyas kyi sku chos can/ khyod la gsum kho nar grangs nges te/ khyod gsum du grangs nges pa'am/ bzhir grangs nges pa gang rung gang zhig khyod bzhir grangs nges na/ lus rnam gzhag tu ngo bo nyid ces bya ba'i sgra'i mjug thob de ma thag du chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung rigs pa las de mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro zhes zer ro/

/gnyis pa ni/ gzhanaṃ dag lus rnam bzhag tu chos sku mdzad pa bcas pa ste zhes chos sku mjug du smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ lus rnam bzhag gi tshigs bcad sbyar bde ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir dang / ye shes kho na dang mdzad pa sbyar ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ'i phyiṃr bstan bcos 'dir chos can/ sku bzhir grangs nges pa la phyogs mthun gyi lung yod de/ sngags kyi theg pa nas kyang sku bzhir gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yon tan gyi khyad par la gnyis te/ nyon mongs med pa'i khyad par/ smon gnas shes pa'i khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyaṃn thoṃs nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyaṃn dang nyaṃn nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las dman te/ mi'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa skye rung 'gog pa tsam gyi byed las can yin gyi nyon mongs kyi rgyun drung nas 'byin mi nus pa'i phyir/ groṃng dang deṃ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de chos can/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las khyad par du 'phags te/ chos ston pa'i sgo nas gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i rgyun drung nas 'byin nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyaṃn thoṃs sangs rgyas smon gnas mkhyen pa ni zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa'i khyad par bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sangaṃs dang deṃ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa chos can/ nyan thos kyi smon gnas shes pa las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/

lhun gyis grub pa sogs khyad chos lnga ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ nyaṃn thoṃs nyan thos kyi smon gnas shes pa chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa las dman te/ lhun gyis grub pa sogs khyad chos lnga las ldog pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis te/ chos sku rtag pa la rtsod pa spong ba/ khyab rtag gnyis ka la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ skal ldan la snang ba/ skal med la mi snang ba dpes bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtagaṃ tuṃ rgyud ni yongs su smin gyur nas zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ chos sku rtag pa yin na/ rtag tu ji ltar don mi mdzad ces pa'i lan gdab pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyuṃ dang deṃ dgeṃ chos sku chos can/ skal ldan la rtag tu don mdzad de/ skal ldan la rtag tu don mdzad pa'i smon lam grub pa'i phyir/ rangaṃ giṃ chos sku chos can/ skal med la dngos su mi snang ste/ skal med la dngos su snang ba'i rgyu ma tshang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ jiṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lhaṃ dang dpeṃr chos sku skal med la dngos su mi snang ba chos can/ khyod kyi dpe yod de/ lha'i dbang pos char phab kyang sa bon rul ba las myu gu mi 'byung ba de khyod kyi dpe yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yeṃ sheṃs de ltar mdzad pa rgya che ba'i phyir zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ chos sku rtag pa yin na/ skad cig re re la 'byung ba dang / khyab pa yin na rgyud so sor nges pa mi 'thad ces pa'i lan btab pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ dang deṃ chos sku chos can/ khyab pa zhes brjod de/ gzhan don rgya che ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ rtag pa zhes brjod de/ 'khor ba ji srid par rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir/

gsum pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr byams mgon chos can/ chos sku'i 'og tu longs sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos sku de byang sems 'phags pa la longs skur snang ba ston pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshaṃn dang mtshaṃn sa bcu pa la bzhugs pa'i byang sems kho na la snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku chos can/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshan bshad pa/ dpe byad bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshan dngos dang / mtshan gyi rgyu'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mtshaṃn gsuṃm sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyaṃg dang blaṃ longs sku'i phyag dang zhabs kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan chos can/ longs sku'i mtshan yin te/ longs sku de gzhan ngor skyes bu chen por mtshon zhing mthong ba tsam gyis dwang bar mdzad pa'i longs sku'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyuṃ grubaṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃ dang mtshaṃn bla ma rnams la bsu ba dang skyel ba sogs sum cu so gnyis chos can/ mtshan gyi rgyu yin te/ mtshan skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyuṃ deṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ blaṃ maṃ mtshan sgrub byed kyi rgyu sum cu so gnyis po'i lhag ma rnams chos can/ khyod skabs 'dir dngos su ma bstan kyang mi rtogs pa'i skyon med de/ khyod skabs 'dir dngos su ma bstan kyang mdo las rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ tshiṃg leṃ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis chos can/ khyod kyi 'grel pa skabs 'dir dngos su mi 'bri ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyi 'grel pa gong du mtshan bshad par bris zin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa dpe byad bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la sde tshan bcu ste/ sen mo'i dbang du byas pa/ sor mo'i rtse'i/ rtsa'i/ zhabs kyi/ gshegs tshul gyi/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ phyag gi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ dbu 'khor dang bcas pa'i/ dge mtshan gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thubaṃ paṃ'i sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ soraṃ moṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsaṃ miṃ sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ loṃng buṃ sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ sengaṃ geṃ sogs so/ /drug pa ni/ 'khriṃl baṃg sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ phyaṃg niṃ sogs so/ /brgyad pa la drug ste/ zhal gyi dbang du byas pa/ ljags gsung dang bcas pa'i/ mche ba'i/ shangs kyi/ spyan 'khor dang bcas pa'i/ snyan gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ zhaṃl niṃ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ljaṃgs mnyeṃn sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ mcheṃ baṃ sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ shangaṃs mthoṃ sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ spyaṃn yangaṃs sogs so/ /drug pa ni/ phyaṃg ringaṃ sogs so/ /dgu pa ni/ dpraṃl baṃ sogs so/ /bcu pa ni/ dpaṃl gyiṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'duṃ byeṃd longs sku'i sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu chos can/ longs sku'i dpe byad yin te/ chos rtags mtshan gyi skabs dang 'dra/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ /des na mdo sde rgyan las lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na/ /skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar/ /mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i snga phyi gnyis gnyis mtshan dang dpe byad so so la sbyar ba ni dgongs pa min te/ 'grel par gnyis ka la gnyis ka sbyar ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang mtshan dang dpe byad gnyis ka'i skad dod la/ lak+ṣa mi zhes pa yod la/ de ni mtshan nyid dang / mtshon bya dang / bya ba dang / byed pa dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad rnams la 'jug pas tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis mtshan nyid bstan zhing / phyi ma gnyis kyis byed las bstan pa ni gnyis ka la 'dra ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/

/bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr byams mgon chos can/ longs sku'i 'og tu sprul sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ longs sku de sprul skur snang ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃng dang shāṃkyaṃ shākya thub pa chos can/ sprul ba'i sku yin te/ gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi don mnyam du mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brten pa phrin las la gsum las/ dang po ni/ deṃ ltaṃr byams mgon chos can/ khyad par bzhi ldan gyi sku gsum bstan zin nas phrin las 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ kun rdzob du chos sku de longs skur snang ba bskyed/ longs sku de sprul skur snang ba bskyed pa'i sgo nas phrin las mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gduṃl byaṃ'i phrin las nyer bdun chos can/ chos sku'i phrin las yin te/ chos sku'i bdag rkyen la brten nas byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi las yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phrin las kyi dus/ phrin las kyi dbye ba/ phrin las kyi grangs nges so/ /dang po ni/ deṃ bzhiṃn sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa/ lam la 'god pa/ lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'groṃ rnamaṃs sogs so/ /gnyis pa la tshogs lam la 'god pa/ sbyor lam la/ mthong lam la/ sgom lam la 'god pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsduṃ rnamaṃs sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rangaṃ bzhinaṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gnyisaṃ zadaṃ daṃng sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ brdaṃ daṃng sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ myaṃ nganaṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ chosaṃ kyiṃ sogs so/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ phrin las kyi dbye ba/ phrin las kyi dus/ phrin las kyi sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ daṃng poṃr chos sku chos can/ gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god par mdzad de/ gdul bya nges 'byung gi bsam pa la 'god par mdzad pa'i phyir/ sbyiṃn paṃ chos sku chos can/

gdul bya tshogs lam la 'god par mdzad de/ gdul bya bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa la 'god par mdzad pa'i phyir/ deṃ naṃs choṃs chos sku chos can/ gdul bya sbyor lam la 'god par mdzad de/ gdul bya rang bzhin stong pa nyid goms pa la 'god par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de'iṃ rjesaṃ chos sku chos can/ gdul bya sa dang po la 'god par mdzad de/ gdul bya sbyin pa'i phar phyin la brten nas chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pa la 'god par mdzad pa'i phyir/ deṃ nasaṃ tshogaṃs chos sku chos can/ gdul bya sa gnyis pa nas lnga pa'i bar la 'god par mdzad de/ gdul bya tshul khrims la sogs pa'i chos thams cad brdar btags pa tsam du shes pa la 'god pa'i phyir/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ deṃ ltaraṃ chos sku'i phrin las nyer bdun chos can/ rgyun mi chad par 'jug pa yin te/ 'khor ba ji srid par 'jug pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ semaṃs baṃskyed/ dang po sems bskyed dang tha ma chos sku'i phrin las kyi sa mtshams bstan pa'i gzhung chos can/ khyod la brten nas lhag ma bar gyi tshig rnams kyi sa mtshams khong du chud par bya ba yin te/ khyod la brten nas lhag ma bar gyi tshig gi don rnams kyi sa mtshams rtogs par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ tshigaṃ mngaṃ seng ge bzang po chos can/ lhag ma bar gyi tshig gi don rnams kyi sa mtshams 'grel pa 'dir dngos su ma bris pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'grel pa tshig mang du dogs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni shesaṃ raṃb sogs so// //gnyis pa bar pa la dad pa la drug tu bstan pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyasaṃ paṃ byams mgon chos can/ yum don dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad pa'i 'og tu yum don dngos po drug gi sgo nas bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyas pa la dga' ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i 'og tu bar pa la dga' ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ mtshaṃn nyidaṃ byams mgon chos can/ sher phyin yang dag par bshad pa yin te/ sher phyin dngos po drug gi sgo nas mdo ji lta ba bzhin bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dngaṃ poraṃ skabs dang po gsum du bstan pa'i mkhyen gsum chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi las grub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi chos sum cus mtshon par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ naṃs rnam rdzogs sbyor ba chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa sgom pa la sbyor ba'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ naṃs rtse sbyor chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi rab kyi gnas skabs yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa sgom pa las rtogs pa phul byung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ naṃs mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi go rim gyi gnas skabs yin te/ so so ba dang mtha' dag tu rtogs pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ naṃs skad cig ma'i sbyor ba chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa cig char sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ naṃs chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa chos can/ de'i rnam smin yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa sgom pa'i rnam smin mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ ltaṃr yum don chos can/ dngos po drug tu bsdus kyang / mtshon byed kyi chos la khyad par med de/ dngos po drug tu bsdus kyang mtshon byed kyi chos bdun cu'i sgo nas bshad dgos pa'i phyir// //gsum pa bsdus pa la dad pa la gsum du bsdu ba la gsum las/ dang po ni/ baṃr paṃ byams mgon chos can/ yum don dngos po drug gi bshad pa'i 'og tu dngos po gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/

baṃr maṃ la dga' ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i 'og tu bsdus pa la dga' ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yuṃl niṃ rnamaṃ paṃ byams mgon chos can/ yum don yang dag par bshad pa yin te/ yum don dngos po gsum gyi sgo nas mdo ji lta ba bzhin bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ daṃng poṃr skabs dang po gsum du bstan pa'i mkhyen gsum chos can/ 'jug pa'i yul gyi rgyu yin te/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i cha nas mngon rtogs su bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ jiṃ sbyor ba bzhi po chos can/ sbyor ba yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa sgom pa la sbyor ba'i cha nas mngon rtogs su bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ sbyoṃr baṃ chos sku phrin las dang bcas pa chos can/ 'bras bu yin te/ sbyor bzhi bsgoms pa'i rnam smin yin pa'i cha nas mngon rtogs su bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyaṃl baṃ'i yum don chos can/ dngos po gsum du bsdus kyang mtshon byed kyi chos la khyad par med de/ dngos po gsum du bsdus kyang mtshon byed kyi chos bdun cus bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba la lnga ste/ yum gsum brjod bya gcig tu bstan/ 'grel pa ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul/ brtsams pa'i dge ba byang chub bsngo/ nongs pa'i don la bzod par gsol/ yum don rtogs pa'i dus kyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lagaṃs yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum chos can/ brjod bya khyad par med de/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad tshig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi sgo nas bstan par zad pa'i phyir/ deṃ ltaṃr rgyan chos can/ yum gsum char gyi rgyan yin te/ yum gsum char gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad brjod byar bsdus pa gang zhig khyod kyis kyang mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi sgo nas yum gyi rgyan du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /deṃ laṃ yum gsum po chos can/

tshig rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par yod de/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po tshigs bsdus pa dang / 'bring dang / rgyas pa'i sgo nas so sor bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phaṃgs paṃ seng ge bzang pos 'phags pa grol sde'i legs bshad kyi mthu la brten nas bla ma la gnang ba nos te/ bstan bcos kyi tshig re re zhing mdo dang sbyor ba'i lung sbyor rgyas par ma byas par don yang dag par blangs pa'i 'grel pa don gsal brtsams pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ go sla ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ bsdeṃbs slob dpon seng ge bzang pos 'grel pa don gsal brtsams pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dge rtsa chud mi za ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ sheṃs raṃb 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ nongs pa mchis na mkhas pa rnams kyi bzod pa mdzad rigs te/ tshu rol mthong bas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos gang zhig rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa rnam dag gis brtsams pa yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ kyeṃ maṃ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ yum don phyin ci ma log par mthong ba yin te/ yum don la yun ring du sbyangs pa la brten nas mgon po byams pa'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i stobs kyis yum don mthong zhing mthong nas bstan pa rnams rgya bod thams cad du nyi ma'i 'od ltar kun la snyoms par phan pa yin pa'i phyir/ sheṃs rabaṃ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ khyod rtsom pa po'i gang zag yod de/ khyod slob dpon seng ge bzang pos rtsom par kun la grags pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bstan bcos ji ltar bsgyur ba'i tshul ni rgyaṃ garaṃ gyiṃ/ zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban+de dpal brtsegs dang / lo ts+tsha ba blo ldan shes rab kyis 'grel pa don gsal bsgyur ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bod la phan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gzhung lugs pad+mo kha phye nas/ /mngon rtogs ge sar phreng mdzes shing /

/zab don sbrang rtsi 'byung byed pa'i/ /ngag don yid kyi nyi ma 'di/ /shes par 'dod pa'i shes rab dang / /don la sbyor ba'i don gnyer dang / /gzu bor spyod pa'i gzu bo'i blo/ /gsum ldan de la sbyin par bya/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i tshogs/ /gangs ri'i phreng mdzes ltar gsal ba/ /bdag gi rgyud la gang thob des/ /'gro sems bde la 'god par shog /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa don gsal dang bcas pa'i ngag don/ sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges lcags mo glang gi smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes gnyis la dpal e wam̐ chos ldan kyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhon nu bzang po'o// //mad+ga laṃ// ༈ //'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba gang thob pa/ /des ni skye bo thams cad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 104 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi ngag don/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 103
